title: Senior Manager Growth - Europe
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Iterative Health is a healthcare technology and services company powering the acceleration of clinical research to transform patient outcomes.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">We built a leading performance-driven network of 100+ sites across the US, Europe, India, and Australia, conducting research directly in the communities where care is delivered across gastrointestinal, hepatology, obesity, and cardiology. Today, Iterative Health is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and New York City with 250+ employees world-wide.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>As Senior Manager of Growth for Europe, you will be a key strategic partner to the European leadership team helping drive the projects, initiatives, and growth agenda that shape how Iterative Health expands across the region.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a role at the intersection of strategy and execution: you will translate ambitious goals into structured plans, and then make sure those plans get delivered. You will work across a broad range of workstreams — from strategic planning and market development to M&amp;A support and cross-functional project coordination.&nbsp;</p> <p>The common thread is operating as a trusted, high-quality partner to leadership: someone who can pick up a complex topic, structure it clearly, drive it forward, and ensure the right people are aligned and moving. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical foundations, a genuine interest in healthcare and clinical research, and the drive to build something meaningful in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.&nbsp;</p> <p></p> <p>Fluency in English and Polish required.</p> <p></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Location</strong>: Warsaw, Poland or Munich, Germany<br data-start="1587" data-end="1590"><strong>Employment Type:</strong> Full-Time EOR</span></p> <p><strong>Strategic Projects &amp; Execution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with the European leadership team to identify, structure, and prioritize the key strategic initiatives that drive IH's growth and operational excellence across the region.</li> <li>Build and maintain a clear overview of the European initiative landscape - ensuring the right workstreams are resourced, tracked, and delivered against plan.</li> <li>Develop structured project plans, maintain momentum across workstreams, and hold contributors accountable to commitments and deadlines.</li> <li>Independently execute key strategic initiative, coordinate interfaces with other teams and pro-actively escalate roadblocks as needed.</li> <li>Prepare high-quality materials for internal leadership, board, and partner audiences - including strategy presentations, market analyses, business cases, and performance updates.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Growth &amp; Market Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Co-develop IH's European expansion strategy by country together with the European leadership -&nbsp; translating regional ambitions into a concrete, prioritized plan.</li> <li>Monitor market dynamics, competitive landscape, and regulatory developments across the region to surface relevant opportunities and risks early.</li> <li>Independently drive growth initiatives and work closely with site operations teams to ensure growth initiatives are grounded in operational reality.</li> </ul> <p><strong>M&amp;A Support &amp; Site Integration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the operational coordination of M&amp;A diligence processes - managing workstreams, timelines, and information flows across internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Prepare clear, structured materials to support investment decisions - including market analyses, site assessments, and operational summaries.</li> <li>Work closely with US-based finance and legal teams, ensuring the European operational context is well represented throughout diligence and deal processes.</li> <li>Work closely with Site Operations to ensure seamless handover from integration into steady-state delivery.</li> <li>Performs duties as requested&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strategic growth initiatives are clearly defined, tracked, and executed on time - with clear ownership and accountability across workstreams.</li> <li>The European leadership team has a reliable, analytically rigorous partner who improves the quality and speed of strategic decision-making.</li> <li>M&amp;A diligence and integration processes are well coordinated, with IH's operational standards applied consistently to newly acquired sites.</li> <li>IH's footprint and service offering in CEE grows in a structured, well-executed way - with each initiative strengthening the network and market position.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring to the Team</strong></p> <ul> <li>3–5 years at a leading strategy consulting firm (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain, or equivalent) with significant exposure to healthcare, life sciences, or health-tech clients; and/or experience in a high-growth startup, or a strategy or business development role within a pharmaceutical or biotech company.</li> <li>Proven track record of structuring complex problems, managing multi-stakeholder projects, and delivering high-quality, executive-ready outputs under time pressure.</li> <li>Strong analytical rigor — comfortable building models, sizing markets, and driving data-informed recommendations independently.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills; About the team:

The Identity team plays a critical role in delivering secure and seamless experiences for millions of SumUp users worldwide. We build and maintain authentication and account protection services, as well as central identity solutions that enable teams and products across SumUp.

We are a cross-functional, engineering-driven team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team's success.

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp's identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn't required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter.

We're looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. You'll collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to shape requirements, design technical solutions, make implementation decisions, and drive rollouts. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we build and improve our services while making a meaningful impact on the security and experience of SumUp users.

 

What you'll do:

  • Collaborate with other engineers to design and build clean, reliable APIs, such as the next generation of our central Authentication and Permission APIs and facilitate a smooth gradual migration to these new systems.
  • Evolve our authentication and authorization services that serve both internal and external users.
  • Develop and ship solutions that enhance the security of our apps and SDKs, protect millions of users from fraud and account takeovers.
  • Create secure, user-friendly self-service features that empower our users to manage their accounts and contact preferences with confidence.
  • Work with a talented distributed team that values collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Enjoy your work! We are looking for someone to be paid to do what they love.

 

You'll be great for this role if you have:

  • Experience in backend or fullstack development, primarily with Go. Familiarity with other languages like TypeScript, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, or Swift is a big plus and can be helpful for working across different systems.
  • Excitement for security and reliability topics. Experience with authentication and authorization technologies (e.g. OAuth, Multi-Factor Authentication) would be nice to have.
  • A flexible mindset and the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment and navigate complex domains. You are a quick learner and have a proven ability to pick up new skills and concepts swiftly.
  • A structured, proactive way of working. You enjoy working independently but also effectively collaborate with your cross-functional team and other teams.
  • A natural drive to improve things—you're always looking to make systems and processes better. You strive for great solutions, but also know when to be pragmatic.
  • Confidence in asking for help or using available tools (like search engines or AI assistants) when something is beyond your grasp.
  • Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written. As part of a globally distributed team, clear and respectful communication is essential.

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup

🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖️ Generous time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus one extra day per year of service (up to 35), along with public holidays and special leave options

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp

🍽️ Meal support: benefit from a tax-free food voucher program plus flexibility via our Re:Benefits platform

🚌 Easy commute: free shuttle buses connecting directly to Joliot-Curie metro station

🏥 Peace of mind: additional health insurance and life insurance

💪 Stay active: on-site yoga and a co-sponsored Multisport card offering access to hundreds of sports facilities

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

 

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by Company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

 

About us:

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. 

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited.

Explore career opportunities with us and join a team driven by collaboration, innovation, and a shared vision of creating a world where everyone can build a thriving business. Discover more about our vibrant and inclusive work culture and how we work on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn and Instagram.

raw.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Identity
raw.description:
About the team:

The Identity team plays a critical role in delivering secure and seamless experiences for millions of SumUp users worldwide. We build and maintain authentication and account protection services, as well as central identity solutions that enable teams and products across SumUp.

We are a cross-functional, engineering-driven team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team's success.

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp's identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn't required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter.

We're looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. You'll collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to shape requirements, design technical solutions, make implementation decisions, and drive rollouts. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we build and improve our services while making a meaningful impact on the security and experience of SumUp users.

 

What you'll do:

  • Collaborate with other engineers to design and build clean, reliable APIs, such as the next generation of our central Authentication and Permission APIs and facilitate a smooth gradual migration to these new systems.
  • Evolve our authentication and authorization services that serve both internal and external users.
  • Develop and ship solutions that enhance the security of our apps and SDKs, protect millions of users from fraud and account takeovers.
  • Create secure, user-friendly self-service features that empower our users to manage their accounts and contact preferences with confidence.
  • Work with a talented distributed team that values collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Enjoy your work! We are looking for someone to be paid to do what they love.

 

You'll be great for this role if you have:

  • Experience in backend or fullstack development, primarily with Go. Familiarity with other languages like TypeScript, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, or Swift is a big plus and can be helpful for working across different systems.
  • Excitement for security and reliability topics. Experience with authentication and authorization technologies (e.g. OAuth, Multi-Factor Authentication) would be nice to have.
  • A flexible mindset and the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment and navigate complex domains. You are a quick learner and have a proven ability to pick up new skills and concepts swiftly.
  • A structured, proactive way of working. You enjoy working independently but also effectively collaborate with your cross-functional team and other teams.
  • A natural drive to improve things—you're always looking to make systems and processes better. You strive for great solutions, but also know when to be pragmatic.
  • Confidence in asking for help or using available tools (like search engines or AI assistants) when something is beyond your grasp.
  • Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written. As part of a globally distributed team, clear and respectful communication is essential.

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup

🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖️ Generous time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus one extra day per year of service (up to 35), along with public holidays and special leave options

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp

🍽️ Meal support: benefit from a tax-free food voucher program plus flexibility via our Re:Benefits platform

🚌 Easy commute: free shuttle buses connecting directly to Joliot-Curie metro station

🏥 Peace of mind: additional health insurance and life insurance

💪 Stay active: on-site yoga and a co-sponsored Multisport card offering access to hundreds of sports facilities

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by Company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

 

About us:

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. 

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited.

As our Founding Marketing Manager, you'll build Kuro's marketing function from the ground up and shape how we become a leading technology brand in the European construction industry. You'll own our brand, campaigns, and events, turning customer success stories into compelling content and building a repeatable marketing engine that drives awareness, engagement, and inbound demand.

Your Profile

  • Proven experience building and growing a technology brand, with hands-on ownership of content, account-based marketing, campaigns, and events.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Identity
description: <p><strong>About the team:</strong></p> <p>The Identity team plays a critical role in delivering secure and seamless experiences for millions of SumUp users worldwide. We build and maintain authentication and account protection services, as well as central identity solutions that enable teams and products across SumUp.</p> <p>We are a cross-functional, engineering-driven team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team's success.</p> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp's identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn't required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter.</p> <p>We're looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. You'll collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to shape requirements, design technical solutions, make implementation decisions, and drive rollouts. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we build and improve our services while making a meaningful impact on the security and experience of SumUp users.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with other engineers to design and build clean, reliable APIs, such as the next generation of our central Authentication and Permission APIs and facilitate a smooth gradual migration to these new systems.</li> <li>Evolve our authentication and authorization services that serve both internal and external users.</li> <li>Develop and ship solutions that enhance the security of our apps and SDKs, protect millions of users from fraud and account takeovers.</li> <li>Create secure, user-friendly self-service features that empower our users to manage their accounts and contact preferences with confidence.</li> <li>Work with a talented distributed team that values collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Enjoy your work! We are looking for someone to be paid to do what they love.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>You’ll be great for this role if you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in backend or fullstack development, primarily with Go. Familiarity with other languages like TypeScript, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, or Swift is a big plus and can be helpful for working across different systems.</li> <li>Excitement for security and reliability topics. Experience with authentication and authorization technologies (e.g. OAuth, Multi-Factor Authentication) would be nice to have.</li> <li>A flexible mindset and the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment and navigate complex domains. You are a quick learner and have a proven ability to pick up new skills and concepts swiftly.</li> <li>A structured, proactive way of working. You enjoy working independently but also effectively collaborate with your cross-functional team and other teams.</li> <li>A natural drive to improve things—you're always looking to make systems and processes better. You strive for great solutions, but also know when to be pragmatic.</li> <li>Confidence in asking for help or using available tools (like search engines or AI assistants) when something is beyond your grasp.</li> <li>Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written. As part of a globally distributed team, clear and respectful communication is essential.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Why you should join SumUp:</strong></p> <p>🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Sofia office. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Wolt&nbsp; powering decision-making across our 3 sided marketplace.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Senior Data Scientist</strong> to join our <strong>Berlin </strong>&nbsp;team. In this role, you’ll drive high-quality decision-making to maximise impact.&nbsp;</p> <p>We’re hiring multiple Senior Data Scientists across different areas of the business. Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope, remit and team.</p> <p><strong>About Our Data Science Organisation</strong></p> <p>We have an outstanding Data Science organisation, with a mission to drive the highest quality decision-making across our marketplace. We work throughout the company, in product, operations, and platform teams and are uniquely placed to use data to help make better decisions and improve data literacy across Wolt. We are great communicators, and move fast to serve our customers a little better every day.</p> <p>Our community is highly active, and Data Scientists can progress equally as IC leads or managers.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science; many are not.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the front lines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.</p> <p><strong>Our humble expectations</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in a Data Analytics or Data Science position.</li> <li>Expertise in statistical analysis, including hypothesis testing and experimentation (A/B testing and causal inference) using statistical software packages in Python, R, or equivalent for product development.</li> <li>Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets.</li> <li>Prior experience building intuitive data visualizations and dashboards that influence business decisions, utilizing tools like Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, or similar.</li> <li>Clear and concise communication with strong cross-functional partnership experience.</li> <li>Relentless pursuit of new ideas and data sources, and the ability to systematically tackle ambiguous problems with a data-driven, hypothesis-based approach.</li> <li>Ability to work and communicate effectively in English.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer</strong></p> <ul> <li>The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.</li> <li>You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Berlin, Helsinki or Stockholm. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.</span></p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.</p> <p>Here, the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce but to build your own.</p> <h4><strong>Your Impact</strong></h4> <p><strong><span class="">Hello!</span> I'm Roberto Olmeda, leading the Search Discovery Team at commercetools.&nbsp;</strong>Search is fundamentally changing shape. Shoppers are moving from keywords to full sentences—and increasingly, the client querying our APIs isn’t a human at all, it’s an AI agent. My team builds the core retrieval layer behind product discovery for the world’s most demanding commerce brands. As we take semantic and hybrid search to general availability, we’re tackling hard engineering problems at every layer: from query understanding and vector indexing down to latency, measurable relevance, and the cost of a single query. <strong>We’re looking for a Senior Search Engineer to build across Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, and our functional Scala backend—whether you already love functional programming or are excited to master it with us.</strong></p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend</li> <li>Develop search capabilities that combine lexical, semantic, and hybrid retrieval</li> <li>Develop search-related libraries based on ElasticSearch and MongoDB</li> <li>Contribute to search relevance and quality, and to how we measure it</li> <li>Run and maintain a scalable search “infrastructure as code” on top of Kubernetes using terraform and multi-tenant architecture</li> <li>Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps</li> <li>Learn Scala and functional programming as your new main development tools</li> <li>Take part in on-call rotation with a worldwide distributed team for production systems</li> </ul> <p><em>This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our</em><strong><em> Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia</em></strong><em> office.&nbsp;</em></p> <h4><strong>What Sets You Apart</strong></h4> <p>You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.</p> <p>Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work. You do not need to be an ML researcher for this role. You need to be a strong backend engineer who is genuinely interested in retrieval quality.</p> <p>You bring:</p> <ul> <li>At least 5 years of experience as a Software Engineer, with production experience on the JVM</li> <li>Solid understanding of parallel and asynchronous programming, as well as non-blocking I/O</li> <li>Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable architectures, including sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover</li> <li>Interest in working with Scala using pragmatic functional programming patterns. If you come from another JVM language, we will support you in picking it up.</li> <li>Fluent English for work in international teams</li> <li>Experience operating multi-tenant SaaS where one tenant’s load must never affect another’s</li> <li>Knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures, including queues and notification topics</li> <li>A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.</li> </ul> <p>Nice to Have:<strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on search experience, preferably ElasticSearch or OpenSearch, including a working understanding of how an inverted index scores and ranks documents</li> <li>Practical exposure to vector retrieval, such as embeddings, approximate nearest neighbor indexes, and hybrid ranking, and a sense of where each approach breaks down. A deep lexical search background plus a clear appetite to go into this territory also works.</li> <li>Comfort reasoning about relevance with data, including precision and recall tradeoffs, ranking metrics, and behavioral signals</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure work and other technologies like Helm, Kubernetes, and Rust</li> </ul> </div> </section> </div> <h4><strong>Our Benefits</strong></h4> <p>Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.</p> <p>🩺 <strong>Comprehensive health benefits</strong> for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support</p> <p>📚 <strong>Learning and development </strong>opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs</p> <p>🍼 <strong>Family Leave Plus</strong> gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition</p> <p>📈 <strong>Our equity participation program</strong> allows you to share in our success&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information on our benefits, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/our-benefits">visit this page.</a></p> <p><strong>Come as you are. Build with us.</strong></p> <p>Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.</p> <p>We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community.&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information on our diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/dei-esg">visit this page</a>.&nbsp;</p> </div> </section> </div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers. The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together they are the engine of commerce innovation today. At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits. Here the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.</p> <h2 data-path-to-node="2">Your Impact</h2> <p class="first-token" data-path-to-node="0"><span class="">Hello!</span> I'm <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/emil-pfrang-b8b00a65/">Emil Pfrang</a>,<span class=""> <strong>Director Information Security</strong> at commercetools. Trust is the foundation of modern cloud commerce. My team operates right at the intersection of global privacy law, cloud architecture, and AI innovation—ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains compliant, resilient, and trusted by the world’s most ambitious enterprises. Rather than treating compliance as a static checkbox exercise, we partner closely with product, engineering, and external clients to navigate evolving global regulations and safely bring new AI capabilities to market</span></p> <p>As a <strong>Data Protection and Compliance Consultant</strong>, you will play a critical role in maintaining and elevating commercetools’ global data privacy and compliance framework. Operating at the intersection of legal requirements, cloud technology, and software engineering, you will advise internal teams, work closely with external clients, and ensure our multi-tenant SaaS platform adheres to international data privacy laws (such as GDPR, and relevant global privacy regulations).</p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <p><strong>Data protection and privacy advice</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) on global data protection laws (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA where applicable, UK GDPR, etc.) for internal product, engineering, and business teams</li> <li>Advise departments on privacy and data protection topics</li> <li>Work with department heads and process owners to collect all required information about each processing activity</li> <li>Check and assess vendors and assets for data protection and privacy as part of the supplier assessments</li> <li>Monitor and handle the privacy related requests from employees, customers, and authorities, e.g. requests for information, requests for deletion, etc.</li> <li>Prepare and review Data Transfer Impact Assessments&nbsp;</li> <li>Check and assess AI tools and features from a privacy perspective</li> <li>Review customer Data Processing Agreements (DPAs)&nbsp;</li> <li>Support assessments of AI tools and AI features from a privacy perspective</li> </ul> <p><strong>Audits, strategic compliance and maintenance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor global legal developments, court rulings, and regulatory guidance to update commercetools’ internal policies continuously</li> <li>Maintenance of process documentation within data protection</li> <li>Design and manage data protection training together with our external DPO</li> <li>Draft, review, and maintain key privacy documentation, including Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), Privacy Policies, and Privacy Notices</li> <li>Maintain the Record of Processing Activities (RoPA)</li> <li>Support audits from privacy and data protection perspective&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Provide data protection evidence for internal and external audits</li> <li>Execute internal compliance audits: Support departments on identifying compliance needs</li> <li>Support compliance policy management</li> <li>Maintenance of whistleblower platform&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What Sets You Apart</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="8">You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork. Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work.</p> <p data-path-to-node="9">&nbsp;<strong data-path-to-node="9" data-index-in-node="0">You bring:</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="10"> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Fluent English and German</strong></li> <li>Degree in law, business informatics or a related field, or equivalent experience</li> <li>2+ years of experience in data protection or privacy compliance, ideally at a SaaS or tech company</li> <li>Solid knowledge of the GDPR (Art. 13–21, 28, 30, 35, 44 ff.). Knowledge of the EU AI Act, CCPA or HIPAA is a plus</li> <li>Experience with privacy management tools, ideally OneTrust</li> <li>Understanding of ISMS frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2)</li> <li>Structured, detail-oriented way of working with a strong focus on documentation</li> <li>Professional certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT (IAPP), or CISA are a strong advantage</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="10,13,0"><strong data-path-to-node="11" data-index-in-node="0">AI Aptitude:</strong> A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.</p> <p data-path-to-node="13"><strong>Our Benefits</strong></p> </div> </div> </div> <p>Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.</p> <p>🩺 <strong>Comprehensive health benefits</strong> for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support</p> <p>📚 <strong>Learning and development </strong>opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs</p> <p>🍼 <strong>Family Leave Plus</strong> gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition</p> <p>📈 <strong>Our equity participation program</strong> allows you to share in our success&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information on our benefits, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/our-benefits">visit this page.</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Come as you are. Build with us.</strong></p> <p>Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.</p> <p>We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community.&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information on our diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/dei-esg">visit this page</a>.&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you'll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. You'll take ideas from concept to production quickly, prove what works, and turn the best of it into patterns the wider engineering organisation can adopt.</p> <p>You'll work closely with product and commercial leaders to find where AI changes the economics of our affiliate marketing platform: what we can build, how fast, and at what cost. You'll be hands-on most of the time, writing code, shipping and measuring results, rather than coordinating others.</p> <p>You'll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won't be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real.</p> <p><strong>This is a step-up opportunity.</strong> We're looking for a bright, self-starting engineer who is ready for more scope than their current role allows. You might not have held a principal title yet. What matters is that you're already building this way, you learn fast, and you want the room to prove it. You'll have direct access to senior leadership, real problems with commercial weight, and the freedom to choose how you solve them.</p> <p><strong>Key tasks and accountabilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Build and ship</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build and run AI-powered products, tools and services from prototype to production</li> <li>Own outcomes end to end: problem framing, architecture, implementation, evaluation, release and operation</li> <li>Run fast, time-boxed experiments; scale what works and stop what doesn't, with the evidence to back either call</li> <li>Set up and evolve the AI infrastructure these builds rely on: model access, evaluation tooling, observability and guardrails</li> </ul> <p><strong>Shape direction</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with the VP Technology to set Awin's engineering-specific AI direction, grounded in what has actually been built and measured</li> <li>Scope strategic opportunities early with product and commercial leaders, with effort, cost and value made explicit</li> <li>Make clear recommendations on build vs buy, model and vendor choice, and where AI should not be used</li> </ul> <p><strong>Architecture and design</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design new capability so it connects safely to the existing platform: APIs, events, data and identity</li> <li>Select tools and technologies, and define the patterns and practices for AI-native development at Awin</li> <li>Weigh long-term maintainability, economic viability and reuse against speed, and document the trade-offs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Spread what works</strong></p> <ul> <li>Turn proven builds into reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, and share them so other teams can adopt them without hand-holding</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ways of working</strong></p> <ul> <li>Works autonomously, guided by the VP Technology's priorities rather than team-level delivery processes</li> <li>Engages directly with engineering, product, data, security and commercial stakeholders as each build requires</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills &amp; Expertise</strong></p> <p><strong>AI-native engineering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Builds with coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as the default way of working. Can show how they decompose work, manage context and review agent output to get production-quality code at pace</li> <li>Has shipped LLM-powered features to production: prompt and context engineering, tool use and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval (RAG) and multi-step agent workflows</li> <li>Builds evaluations first: test sets, automated evals and regression checks for non-deterministic behaviour, with quality measured before and after release</li> <li>Connects models to enterprise systems and data safely, e.g. MCP servers, internal APIs and event streams, with clear permissions and audit trails</li> <li>Understands model selection, token economics, latency, caching and fallback strategies, and can explain cost and benefit trade-offs to commercial stakeholders</li> <li>Designs for AI-specific security and privacy risks: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling under GDPR, and guardrails on what models can do</li> </ul> <p><strong>Engineering foundations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Expert in at least one modern language (Python or TypeScript ideal), and able to work in our existing Java, PHP and JavaScript estate when integrating</li> <li>Strong cloud-native and serverless architecture on AWS, with infrastructure as code (Terraform)</li> <li>Experience with event-driven and distributed systems (Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS) and with relational and non-relational data stores</li> <li>Builds observability into everything: tracing, logging and monitoring, including LLM-specific telemetry</li> <li>Treats automated testing, CI/CD and secure-by-default design as standard, and automates as much of the delivery loop as possible</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ways of building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Takes an idea to a working prototype in days, then hardens it for production, and knows when to stop</li> <li>Leaves behind reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, not one-off solutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft skills</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Bias to action:</strong> ships, measures and iterates rather than waiting for perfect requirements</li> <li><strong>Comfortable with ambiguity:</strong> frames vague opportunities into concrete, testable bets</li> <li><strong>Commercially minded:</strong> connects technical choices to revenue, cost and customer outcomes, and balances effort against value</li> <li><strong>Intellectually honest:</strong> kills their own ideas when the evidence says so, and says plainly where AI is not the answer</li> <li><strong>Clear communicator:</strong> explains technical trade-offs to executives, engineers and commercial teams in language each understands, in writing and in person</li> <li><strong>Influences without authority:</strong> gets teams to adopt new patterns because they work, not because they're mandated</li> </ul> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><strong>Our Offer</strong></div> <ul class="RichTextList-bulleted"> <li> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><strong>Flexi-Week</strong>: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.</div> </li> <li> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><strong>Flexi-office</strong>: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.</div> </li> <li> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><strong>Work Expense Contribution &amp; Remote Working Furniture</strong>: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home.</div> </li> <li> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><strong>Health and Wellbeing</strong>: With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.</div> </li> <li> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><strong>Development</strong>: We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.</div> </li> <li> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><strong>Appreciation</strong>: Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme.</div> </li> </ul> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><em>We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview.</em></div> <p>Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.</p> <p>Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.</p> <p>Diversity &amp; Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.</p> <p><span class="TextRun Highlight SCXW248400944 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8">Awin is part of the Axel Springer group.</span></span> <span class="TextRun Highlight SCXW248400944 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8">Learn more at&nbsp;</span></span><a class="Hyperlink SCXW248400944 BCX8" href="https://www.axelspringer.com/en/" target="_blank"><span class="TextRun Highlight Underlined SCXW248400944 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8" data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">axelspringer.com/</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8" data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">en</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8" data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">/</span></span></a><span class="TextRun Highlight SCXW248400944 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8">, and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here:</span></span> <a class="Hyperlink SCXW248400944 BCX8" href="https://www.axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why" target="_blank"><span class="TextRun Highlight Underlined SCXW248400944 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8" data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why</span></span></a><span class="TextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8">&nbsp;</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW248400944 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>Apply now to begin the next stage of your career at a progressive company that supports both your professional and personal development.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-RS1</span></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Channel Sales
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Recruitment Fraud Alert</strong></p> <p>We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number. &nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What to know:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Commvault does&nbsp;<em>not</em>&nbsp;conduct interviews by email or text.</li> <li>We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.</li> <li>Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.</li> </ul> <p>If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at <u><a ---------- <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About Commvault</strong></p> <p>Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.</p></div><p>As Channel Director for DACH, you will manage all channel sales and business development aspects of indirect business in the defined region. title: Senior Account Executive, Enterprise
description: Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact. At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses. We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart : trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive. So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops. Adventure Ahead 🚀 Step into a high-impact role as a Senior Account Executive for Enterprise Sales in DACH, where you will drive strategic growth across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. You’ll partner with major enterprises to transform how they approach learning, enablement, and skills development—turning complex business priorities into measurable, real-world outcomes. Working alongside a powerhouse team of Solutions Consultants, BDRs, and executive leaders, you’ll own the full customer journey from bold territory strategy to celebratory contract close, directly shaping Docebo’s footprint in one of Europe’s most dynamic markets. The Day-to-Day 💻 Command Your Territory: Own and expand a portfolio of named and strategic enterprise accounts across DACH, smashing ARR, pipeline-generation, and new-business targets through sharp account planning and whitespace mapping. Orchestrate Winning Deals: Lead complex, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles from initial discovery to signed agreement, mobilizing BDRs, Solutions Consultants, Legal, Security, Value Engineering, and partners to deliver seamless evaluations and RFPs. Champion Buyer-Centric Selling: Guide buying committees—from HR and L&D to IT, Finance, and C-suite economic buyers—through Docebo’s buyer-centric sales stages and MEDDPICC qualification, building internal consensus around clear, evidence-based milestones. Quantify Real Business Impact: Run high-impact discovery sessions to uncover core business drivers and the cost of inaction, crafting executive-ready ROI narratives and defensible business cases that withstand Finance-level scrutiny. Translate Learning into Capability: Connect Docebo’s Learning Suite (LMS, LXP, content, analytics, and skills frameworks) to critical enterprise initiatives like onboarding, compliance, sales enablement, and workforce upskilling. Drive Predictable Execution: Maintain inspection-ready forecasting and deal hygiene in Salesforce and Gong while partnering with RevOps and regional leadership to refine repeatable enterprise plays and represent Docebo at key DACH industry events. Your Superpowers 🦸‍♀️ 7+ years of proven success closing complex B2B SaaS enterprise new-business deals, consistently exceeding quotas and building pipeline in named or strategic territories. Deep mastery of value-based selling, executive business-case creation, commercial negotiation, and structured qualification frameworks like MEDDPICC. Natural ability to map intricate buying committees, cultivate internal champions, engage C-level economic buyers, and align cross-functional internal teams without overpromising. Strong command of enterprise LMS/LXP platforms or adjacent HR tech (HCM, HRIS, talent, or enablement), paired with a working knowledge of skills-based talent development. Sharp analytical and forecasting habits using Salesforce, Gong, and modern prospecting tools, backed by the strategic judgment to qualify out poor-fit opportunities early. Fluency in English and German Ability to travel regularly across DACH and to selected EMEA customer meetings or events (approximately 20–30%). Bonus Points 🌟 Direct experience selling enterprise learning, LMS/LXP, HR Tech, or workforce-development solutions, ideally backed by existing relationships with DACH HR, L&D, Talent, or IT leaders. Hands-on familiarity with global learning programs serving external audiences (customers and partners), as well as complex enterprise security reviews, integrations, and RFP-led evaluations. Background thriving in an international, remote-first SaaS environment with a track record of coaching and elevating fellow sellers. Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉 Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People: Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success. Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being. Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul. Our Promise to You 😍 Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package. Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it. Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off! Family First : We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025! Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long. About Docebo 💙 At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs ( TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO ), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values— Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection —that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world. Docebo is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer . We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our workforce. All qualified applicants and employees will receive consideration for employment regardless of their race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, genetic information, or any other category protected under applicable law. As a federal contractor, Docebo is committed to the principles of affirmative action and equal employment opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Docebo does not discriminate because of protected veteran status or on the basis of disability, and Docebo takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Any individuals requiring a reasonable accommodation or would like to voluntarily disclose a disability or protected veteran status to assist with their employment application should send an e-mail to their recruiter directly. description: Unser Partner ist eine etablierte D2C-Lifestyle-Brand für Food & Beverage-Produkte. Du beobachtest Plattformen, Trends und neue Formate und testest kontinuierlich, was für unsere Marke funktionieren könnte. Analytisches Denken und Freude daran, herauszufinden, warum etwas funktioniert – oder eben nicht. Neugier und die Bereitschaft, Neues auszuprobieren und on the job dazuzulernen. Idealerweise Erfahrung mit einer Lifestyle- oder Consumer Brand, beispielsweise aus den Bereichen Food & Beverage, Beauty oder Fashion. Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, insbesondere mit Blick auf unseren Fokus auf den deutschen Markt. Erfahrung mit Upper-Funnel-Marketing bzw. Demand Generation ist ein Plus.   • Du hast Erfahrung in der Angebotserstellung, Aufwandsschätzung und Budgetsteuerung und verstehst die wirtschaftliche Seite von Projekten.

  • Du bist organisatorisch, konzeptionell und operativ stark, kommunizierst souverän mit Kunden und kannst Ergebnisse fachlich beurteilen.

  • KI ist fester Teil deiner Arbeitsweise. Du arbeitest souverän mit Tools wie Claude, Claude Code oder ChatGPT, hast bereits eigene KI-Workflows aufgebaut oder Arbeitsabläufe damit spürbar verbessert und kannst uns konkret zeigen, wie.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und pragmatisch, findest Lösungen statt Probleme weiterzugeben und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung.

  • Du hast Spaß an Abwechslung, denkst über deinen eigenen Aufgabenbereich hinaus und möchtest dich fachlich und technologisch weiterentwickeln.

Was uns wichtiger ist als ein perfekter Lebenslauf: Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Marketing, denkst mit, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Dinge zuverlässig ins Ziel. Und du hast richtig Lust darauf, gemeinsam mit uns herauszufinden, wie modernes Marketing mit KI noch besser funktionieren kann.

Warum Effecticore?

Weil gute Arbeit Spaß machen darf. Und das Leben neben der Arbeit genauso wichtig ist.

Wir verbringen einen großen Teil unserer Zeit miteinander. Deshalb ist uns wichtig, dass wir nicht nur gut zusammenarbeiten, sondern auch menschlich auf einer Wellenlänge sind. Wir mögen unkomplizierte Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege, gegenseitige Unterstützung und eine ordentliche Portion Humor.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

  • Flexibilität, die wirklich gelebt wird. Zwei bis drei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind bei uns ganz normal. Wann du sie nutzt, stimmen wir flexibel miteinander ab. Auch private Termine zwischendurch oder kurzfristiger Urlaub sind kein Problem. Unsere üblichen Arbeitszeiten liegen ungefähr zwischen 9 und 18 Uhr – mit genügend Spielraum für das echte Leben.

  • Verantwortung und Freiraum. Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen, kannst eigene Entscheidungen treffen und Projekte und Prozesse aktiv mitgestalten.

  • Raum für KI und neue Ideen. Du bekommst Zugang zu professionellen KI-Tools und die Freiheit, damit zu experimentieren, neue Workflows zu entwickeln und Prozesse zu optimieren – ausdrücklich während deiner Arbeitszeit.

  • Ein Team, in dem die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, kommunizieren auf Augenhöhe und lachen viel. Freiwillige Teamabende und gemeinsame Aktionen gehören auch dazu.

  • Workation in Kroatien. Einmal im Jahr tauschen wir unser Büro gegen eine Villa in Kroatien und verbringen dort eine gemeinsame Woche mit Arbeiten, Sonne und Teamzeit.

  • Weiterentwicklung, die zu dir passt. Wir unterstützen individuelle Fortbildungen und geben dir die Möglichkeit, deine Stärken auszubauen und neue Themen für dich zu entdecken.

  • Ein Arbeitsplatz zum Wohlfühlen. Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, hochwertige Ausstattung, gute Erreichbarkeit, kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks. Und auch Hunde sind bei uns willkommen.

  • Wellpass für deine Gesundheit. Ob Gym, Yoga, Schwimmen oder Wellness – mit Wellpass unterstützen wir dich dabei, auch außerhalb der Arbeit etwas für dich zu tun.

Und vielleicht das Wichtigste: Wir nehmen unsere Arbeit ernst, aber nicht wichtiger als alles andere.

Natürlich wollen wir für unsere Kunden richtig gute Ergebnisse erzielen. Wir sind Dienstleister, wir übernehmen Verantwortung und manchmal muss auch etwas kurzfristig möglich gemacht werden.

Aber wir glauben nicht daran, dass gute Kundenarbeit bedeutet, ständig erreichbar zu sein, regelmäßig Überstunden zu machen oder das eigene Privatleben hintenanzustellen.

Wir wollen gemeinsam erfolgreich sein, gute Arbeit leisten und dabei auch noch Spaß haben.

Denn am Ende sollen nicht nur unsere Kunden gerne mit uns arbeiten. Sondern wir auch gerne miteinander.

Klingt nach dir?

Du hast beim Lesen schon überlegt, welche Projekte du bei uns übernehmen und welche Prozesse du mit KI verbessern könntest?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!

raw.title: Werkstudent:in Marketing & PR
raw.description:
Wir machen Content. Für andere.

Für uns selbst kommen wir viel zu selten dazu. Genau da kommst du ins Spiel.

Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere eigene Außenwirkung in die Hand nimmt: Social-Kanäle, Pressearbeit, Website, Newsletter und so weiter! Das heißt nicht Kaffee holen und Listen pflegen, sondern: Du bist die Person, durch die die Branche mitbekommt, was wir eigentlich alles bauen. Awards, Cases, Launches, Team-News, Festival-Auftritte. Wir haben viel zu erzählen und erzählen es gerade viel zu leise.

Du musst nichts davon schon perfekt können. Wir brauchen jemanden, der schreiben kann, der mitdenkt und der Dinge zu Ende bringt. Den Rest zeigen wir dir.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission, falls du sie annimmst:

  • Unsere Social-Kanäle: Du planst, textest und veröffentlichst unsere eigenen Postings – Cases, Behind the Scenes, Team, Awards. LinkedIn ist unsere wichtigste Bühne. Dort findet unsere Branche statt: Kunden,Partner, potenzielle Kolleg:innen. Du sorgst dafür, dass dort regelmäßig etwas passiert, was nicht nach Unternehmensmeldung klingt. Instagram läuft parallel.

  • Award-Einreichungen: Du bereitest Cases für Awards und Festivals auf. Daten sammeln, Texte bauen, Fristen im Blick behalten.

  • Pressearbeit: Du schreibst Entwürfe für Pressemitteilungen, pflegst unseren Presseverteiler, behältst im Blick, wer in der Branche über was schreibt, und findest heraus, wo unsere Themen hinpassen.

  • Newsletter: Du hilfst uns, unseren Newsletter aufzubauen und zu befüllen – Themen sammeln, Texte schreiben, versenden, schauen was gelesen wird.

  • Website & Cases: Du hältst unsere Referenzen aktuell, damit wir nicht mit Projekten von vorgestern werben.

  • Mitdenken: Wenn dir auffällt, dass wir eine gute Geschichte liegen lassen, sagst du Bescheid. Oder machst sie einfach.

Die Strategie dahinter machen wir gemeinsam. Du musst nicht alleine entscheiden, wo die Reise geht – aber du bist die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass tatsächlich etwas rausgeht.

Qualifikation

Was wir wirklich brauchen:

  • Du kannst schreiben. Klar, lesbar, ohne Marketing-Floskeln und bestenfalls ist KI nur ein Begleiter. Das ist der Kern dieser Rolle.

  • Du bist eingeschrieben – idealerweise in Kommunikation, Medien, Marketing, Journalismus, PR oder etwas Benachbartem. Fachrichtung ist uns weniger wichtig als Schreiben und Kopf.

  • Du bringst Dinge zu Ende. Auch die unspektakulären. Ein Presseverteiler pflegt sich nicht von selbst.

  • Du hast ein Gefühl für unsere Branche oder zumindest echtes Interesse daran, was Creator, Brands und Agenturen gerade umtreibt.

Nice to have, kein Ausschluss:

  • Erste Erfahrung in Agentur, Redaktion, Hochschulmarketing oder einem Verein

  • Du hast schon mal einen Newsletter gebaut (Mailchimp, Brevo, Substack, egal)

  • Du bist auf LinkedIn selbst unterwegs und weißt, was dort gelesen wird und was durchrutscht

  • Grundlagen in Canva oder CapCut

  • Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift

Was du nicht brauchst: Agenturerfahrung, ein fertiges Portfolio oder Kenntnisse in zwölf Tools. Das ist eine Werkstudentenstelle, keine getarnte Senior-Position. Wir bauen das zusammen auf.

Benefits

  • Ein Team von Expert:innen: Ein offenes, kleines Expert:innen-Team mit flachen Hierarchien, in dem jede:r mitreden und entscheiden darf. Wir leben eine Kultur, die Fehler erlaubt und das Lernen fördert.

  • Echte Verantwortung: Du bekommst eigene Themen und deinen Namen daran, nicht die Resterampe.

  • Flexible Arbeitskultur: Wir nehmen Rücksicht auf Klausurphasen und Semesterferien – sag früh Bescheid, dann planen wir drumherum.

  • Coole Brands: Du siehst aus nächster Nähe, wie Kampagnen für die coolsten Brands & Creator entstehen.

  • Top-Ausstattung & Benefits: Alles an Technik, was du für deine Arbeit brauchst, inklusive MacBook und wenn du es brauchst auch Deutschlandticket.

  • Merchandise: Das beste Merchandise von allen!

Zahlen, Daten, Fakten:

  • Start: ASAP

  • Arbeitszeit: 20h/Woche, flexibel einteilbar

  • Dauer: 6-12 Monate, gerne länger

  • Perspektive: Bei beidseitigem Gefallen reden wir über die Zeit nach dem Studium

Lust, dafür zu sorgen, dass die Branche endlich mitbekommt, was wir hier machen? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir können es kaum erwarten, Dich kennenzulernen!

XOXO – der Club.

Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.</li> <li><strong>Verpflegung: </strong>Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück und Mittagessen in unserem Büro, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.</li> <li><strong>Unvergessliche Momente:</strong> Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.</li> <li><strong>Ein moderner Workspace:</strong> Unser neu renoviertes Büro ist auf Zusammenarbeit ausgelegt und bietet dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie 30 Urlaubstage (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche).</li> <li><strong>Wohlbefinden &amp; Gleichgewicht:</strong> Wir bieten dir professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp.
