title: AI Modelling and Simulation Engineer
description: The Opportunity Lumai is moving from optical-compute research into production AI systems, and the architecture and compiler decisions that shape the product are being made now, ahead of the silicon that will confirm them. This hire builds the modelling capability those decisions rest on. The Role You will own the performance and power modelling framework that predicts how Lumai's photonic AI hardware performs against real inference workloads, giving the architecture and compiler teams one shared source of truth for latency, throughput and power across device configurations. You will model the compute engines, interconnect, memory and bridge interfaces; keep the model honest by characterising operator-level workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results; and turn what the model says into decisions teams act on. What is genuinely hard about this is balancing speed, fidelity and usability. The model has to capture concurrency, event-driven behaviour and compute-block latency in enough detail to support real architecture decisions, and still compare configurations in minutes rather than overnight. The gap between what the model predicts and what the hardware does has to be measured rather than assumed, and closing it is the part that never stops. What You'll Do Design, build and maintain a Python-based framework that models hardware and software latency, hardware concurrency and event-driven relationships. Model compute engines, interconnect and synchronisation fabric, memory and bridge interfaces, and accelerator blocks across device configurations. Characterise convolution, depthwise convolution, pooling, attention and other operator workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results. Build compiler-agnostic interfaces that ingest compiled models and MLIR from multiple internal compiler flows. Analyse simulation traces with the architecture and compiler teams to improve layer-to-hardware mappings and resolve performance discrepancies. Run industry benchmarks and representative models - UL Procyon, Geekbench AI, Stable Diffusion and contemporary LLMs - to produce decision-ready KPIs. Develop block-level power models and validate worst-case power scenarios with the micro-architecture, verification and physical-design teams. Own the CI/CD pipelines and simulation flows that keep results reliable and reproducible as usage scales. Translate modelling findings into architecture and compiler decisions, setting technical direction and developing engineers or interns as the team grows. What We're Looking For Must-have Proven experience building or substantially extending a hardware/software performance modelling or simulation framework for AI/ML accelerators, ideally in Python. Strong understanding of hardware concurrency, event-driven modelling and AI inference accelerator micro-architecture: compute, memory hierarchy, interconnect and dataflow. Hands-on experience characterising AI operators and correlating model predictions with real hardware or hardware-accurate reference data. Familiarity with compiler internals and intermediate representations such as MLIR, including tooling that consumes compiler output to drive simulation. Strong software engineering and technical leadership practice: framework design, CI/CD ownership, and direction or review of junior engineers' or interns' work. Strong preference for Direct experience with NPU, GPU or other edge or client AI inference accelerator architectures. Experience across multiple compiler toolchains, reconciling architecture-level and production compiler behaviour. Exposure to power modelling, RTL, emulation, FPGA prototyping, photonic compute or another non-traditional compute architecture. About Lumai Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics. In April 2026 we launched the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time. Our first optical computing server is now available for evaluation by hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises and research institutions. Our work won the Falling Walls Award for Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025 and 'Best Overall Technology' at the OCP Future Technologies Symposium. We are headquartered in Oxford. Why Lumai You'll work on a new kind of computer. Optical computing for AI has been promised for decades. We have a working system running real models, and the hard part left is taking it to volume. Your work ships. We are moving from first product to volume production, so what you build this year goes into the servers our customers run. You'll work across disciplines. Optical engineers, machine learning researchers, and hardware and software engineers solve problems together. You will learn things that don't appear on your job description. The work matters beyond Lumai. AI's appetite for energy is one of the defining constraints of the next decade. Our mission is sustainable intelligence at global scale: AI that is faster, cheaper to run and far less power-hungry. You'll join early. You'll have a real say in how we build the product, the team and the way we work. Equal Opportunity Lumai is an equal opportunity employer. raw.description:
Tracksuit exists to help marketers prove their brand building is working. We give teams the data they need to make smarter decisions, convince stakeholders, defend budgets, and track their progress. The brand tracking industry is dominated by 100-page reports, static data and big price-tags. We're doing things differently by being built for the modern marketer: always-on, accessible, and approachable.

We're now tracking more than 16,000 brands across 25 countries globally. With offices in Auckland, Sydney, London and New York City, we're scaling fast with a brilliant team of collaborative and ambitious humans. Our culture is defined by "high care, high performance". We strive to be the best and look after each other while we do it.

Are you our next Agency Sales Development Representative in London?

Brand matters. Most marketers know that already, and so do their agencies. A lot of brands find Tracksuit through the agencies they work with.

As an Agency Sales Development Representative (SDR) in London, you'll start the conversations that grow our agency partner network. You'll find the right agencies, earn a first conversation, and book meetings for our Partner Managers. You'll often be the first person at Tracksuit an agency hears from, online and at industry events. You'll start in the new year, just as we reveal the next chapter of brand tracking in January 2027.

We're hiring at two levels for this role, so whether you're building your outbound skills or already have a strong track record, we'd like to hear from you.

What you'll do

  • Build and prioritise target lists of brand, creative, media and research agencies

  • Research agencies and find the right people to talk to

  • Write and test outreach across email, LinkedIn and phone, using AI tools alongside your own judgement

  • Qualify interest and book meetings for our Partner Managers, with a clear handover

  • Point agencies that aren't ready for a meeting to our partner programme or webinars

  • Go to agency and industry events, meet people face to face, and follow up fast

What you'll bring

  • You start conversations with people you don't know. In writing and in person. Around 1 to 2 years in an SDR, BDR or similar outbound role, ideally in SaaS, marketing technology, advertising or media. Evidence matters more than years.

  • Drive that holds up after a "no". Outbound means hearing no a lot. You keep going, and you work out what to try next.

  • You're organised. You work to targets, keep your CRM tidy, and always know what you're doing next.

  • You want to be coached. You ask for feedback and use it quickly. (Fair warning: you'll get to show us this in the interview.)

  • You like being out and about. Regular events and the occasional evening are part of the job.

Bonus points for agency-side experience or a genuine interest in the agency world.

Why you'll like it here

  • You'll start with a cohort. You'll join alongside other new starters, so you'll learn and ramp up together, not on your own.

  • Time together in the office. With the team in 3 to 4 days a week, you'll pick things up faster: sitting alongside people who've done it before, getting feedback in the moment, and celebrating the wins together.

  • You'll lead with something useful. Agencies get Tracksuit data to support their pitches, so your conversations start with how we can help them win.

  • Two teams in your corner. You'll be coached in Sales and work every day with Partnerships.

  • A clear path to grow. You'll learn how agencies work from the inside, with room to progress.

Salary

We have two pay bands for this role. The band you're offered depends on the skills and experience you show us through the process, not just your years in the job.

  • Agency Sales Development Representative: £36,000 to £44,000 base salary, with on-target earnings (OTE) of £45,000 to £55,000. For people building their outbound skills who want great coaching and a clear path to grow.

  • Agency Sales Development Representative, experienced level: £41,000 to £50,000 base salary, with OTE of £51,000 to £63,000. For people who already book meetings consistently, are confident running conversations at events, and can work the agency world with less support.

The bands overlap on purpose, so we can place you fairly. We'll confirm your band, and where you sit in it, before we make an offer.

OTE is your base salary plus commission when you hit 100% of your target. Commission depends on performance and isn't guaranteed.

The details

  • Location. London, our Clerkenwell office. We're office-first, so you'll be in with the team 3 to 4 days each week.

  • Start date. Offers by the first week of January, with hires starting from mid-January into February.

How our process works

We want to get to know more of the people who apply, not just the ones whose CV tells the whole story. So instead of shortlisting on CVs alone, we'll invite more applicants into the first stage of our process.

That first stage happens in your own time. You'll record a short video interview and complete any other quick online steps, whenever suits you over a few days. It's your chance to show us how you think and what drives you. AI tools help us review these, and a real person makes every decision.

Once we've reviewed the video interviews, shortlisted candidates get a chance to speak with our Talent team about the role and their application in more detail. Then you'll come into our office to interview with the team. We'll let you know exactly what to expect, and anything to prepare, when we invite you.

  • From Monday 23 November: invitations to record your video interview, sent as applications come in

  • Sunday 29 November: applications close

  • Once we've reviewed the video interviews: if you're shortlisted, a chance to talk with our Talent team about the role and your application in more detail

  • Monday 14 to Wednesday 16 December: interviews in our office. That's our goal, though some interviews may take place the following week

  • By the first week of January: outcomes and offers, once we're back from the Christmas break

  • From mid-January into February: new hires start

You'll hear from us either way.

title: Staff Infrastructure Engineer
description: About Antithesis We take cutting edge software-testing technologies and make them useful for finding real bugs in our customer’s software, allowing them to make more reliable software and ship with confidence. Historically we’ve focused on the hardest testing problems, providing deterministic simulation testing of whole distributed systems, finding and helping people to understand bugs that would have been a nightmare to find in production. As more and more code is written by agents, everyone is starting to realise just how important software verification is, and we’re in the process of expanding the problems and companies we target, and are providing an increasingly broad suite of open source and commercial testing tools for a much wider variety of problems and audiences. We’re well funded, deeply technical, and committed to improving the quality of software across the board. If you’d like to help us do that, we’d love to hear from you. About the Role You'd be joining a small London-based team building out a new Antithesis product, focusing on a more downmarket and diverse set of customers than our main product. We’re rapidly iterating and expect to be shipping some time early in the new year. We're looking for an engineer at the Senior to Staff level to help us make that system dependable. This will be “devops” in the traditional sense, though more dev than ops: You'll be a member of the engineering team, not a separate operations function, working in the same repository as everyone else, but your primary area of responsibility will be how the system runs in production. That means AWS, deployment, observability, alerting, and the on-call that comes with them. There will be some on-call, shared with the rest of the team, and part of the job will be helping us define how that works. This is the first product Antithesis is shipping primarily out of the UK, and we want to get things right from the start to make it sustainable and quiet. We’re thinking of this role as less about being the person that gets paged, and more being the person who tries to make sure that nobody does. Likely much of this will have already been prototyped by the time you join, but there will be a lot of latitude to make big changes to how that works. What You'll Do Own our AWS environment. Define and build out our observability and alerting Ensure our continuous deployment story is robust and stress-free in an environment where we expect to change production many times a day. Build and maintain our infrastructure for our fleet of testing VMs for running customers’ code. Take charge of our incident response and make sure we learn from incidents so we don’t repeat them. What We're Looking For An ideal candidate would have most of the following: You have been responsible for a production system on AWS, including being on call for it, and you have opinions about what you would do differently. Fluency with infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Practical experience of observability. You have built alerting that people trusted. Experience operating Postgres: backups, upgrades, migrations, and what happens when they go wrong. Solid Linux, container and networking fundamentals. You are comfortable directing AI coding agents and skeptical of what they produce. Bonus: Experience running agentic systems in production. Sandboxing or isolating untrusted code (microVMs, gVisor, or similar), or security work on a multi-tenant platform. Being the first infrastructure engineer on a team, or building an on-call rotation from nothing. Cost management for bursty, compute-heavy workloads. Nix. About Our Team Our team spans CS degrees, philosophy, mathematics, everything in between, or nothing formal at all. What everyone shares is a high bar for engineering quality. description: About Us Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how. Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development. In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100. At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today. The Role & Key Responsibilities The hands of the Trillion Gene Atlas. You will keep samples moving through our extraction, normalisation, and library preparation pipeline - precisely, reliably, and at pace. Run the daily sample processing pipeline. Execute DNA extraction, normalisation, and library preparation workflows across soil, faecal, and other environmental sample types - following validated SOPs with precision and consistency at high throughput. Operate and maintain laboratory automation. Work with automated liquid handling systems (including Myra9) and other platforms to process samples at batch scale. Perform routine maintenance, troubleshoot instrument issues, and flag deviations from expected performance. Maintain accurate records in LIMS. Log all sample processing steps, QC data, and observations in Benchling LIMS in real time. Ensure full traceability of every sample from receipt through to sequencing dispatch. Perform QC checks and flag anomalies. Carry out quantification, quality checks, and standard analytical assays at key pipeline stages. Identify out-of-specification results, escalate appropriately, and contribute to root cause investigations. Support R&D protocol testing. Assist the R&D team with comparative experiments, kit testing, and protocol optimisation runs as new methods are validated for production. A practical, hands-on contributor to continuous improvement. Maintain a safe, organised lab environment. Uphold high standards of lab hygiene, reagent management, and safety compliance including CL2 working practices. Help keep the lab stocked, organised, and ready to run at scale. Required Skills and Experience Hands-on laboratory experience in a molecular biology or life sciences setting - academic, commercial, or both Practical experience with DNA extraction from biological or environmental samples using kit-based and automated methods Comfortable working at high throughput with strong attention to detail - precise pipetting, consistent technique, reliable record-keeping Experience using LIMS or equivalent electronic lab notebook for sample tracking and data recording Ability to follow SOPs accurately, identify deviations, and escalate clearly and promptly Advantageous Skills and Experience Experience operating automated liquid handling platforms (Hamilton, Tecan, Bravo, or similar) Familiarity with NGS library preparation workflows - even a basic awareness of steps from DNA input to sequencing-ready library Experience with environmental or metagenomic sample types - soils, sediments, faecal, or other challenging matrices CL2 lab certification or prior experience working with GMOs in a contained environment A curiosity about sequencing technology and genuine interest in learning and growing within a fast-moving team What we offer in return Impactful Mission: This is a rare chance to do work that genuinely matters. You'll join a talented, fast-moving team, access unique biological datasets at scale, and see your contributions shape real breakthroughs in AI and curative therapeutics. Collaborative Culture: You'll be surrounded by world-class engineers, scientists, and researchers who care deeply about their work and about each other. With offices in London and Boston, we've built a flexible, cross-functional environment where personal development and real ownership aren't just talking points. High Growth: We truly believe in investing in our people. We make coaching available to team members during steep growth journeys and we have twice-yearly promotion opportunities. People who are really successful here own it and go directly to solve problems at pace, and we ensure reward increases with impact. Comprehensive Benefits: We've built a benefits package people value. That means competitive salary, equity, and private healthcare with no medical history exclusions - so strong that most employees' family members opt into our plan over their own. We also offer Carrot Fertility with IVF stipend, salary sacrifice pension, bike-to-work scheme, life insurance, and more. This role builds our analysis from the start. Every result leaves an instrument as a trace or a vendor file, and it has to become a value someone can rely on, linked back to the sequence and sample it came from. That means fitting it properly, checking it against controls, catching the plate or reagent lot that drifted, and showing the evidence. Someone has to own that work. That is this role. About us AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn’t exist yet, so we’re building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one. We’re in stealth and heads-down on execution. We’ll share more about what we’re building once you’ve spoken with the team. The role You will join the intelligence team and own the analysis of our assay data, and the data and ML infrastructure it runs on, from the point the data has been captured to the result that gets delivered. You will work most closely with the protein characterisation scientists who run the assays, and with the software team, who get data out of the instruments and own the platform it lives on. You build on top of that platform, and you own the quality of the analysis that runs on it. The role is part data engineer and part biostatistician, and all of the data is biological. Much of it is building the analysis and ML pipelines that run on our captured data, and the statistics inside them. The rest is presenting those results clearly, with the statistics that matter, such as uncertainty and QC, shown in a form they can understand. The value is in doing that carefully, in code that behaves the same way on every run. Who you are You have worked with messy experimental data and built things other people relied on. That might have been in a biotech or pharma team, an academic lab, a core facility, or a data-heavy field outside biology where you have since picked up the biology. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you. You are happy to get your hands dirty on the data. Much of the job is careful, repeated work on real instrument output, and we want someone who takes pride in doing that well. You write code other people can run, and you care how a result reads to the person receiving it. Seniority is not what we are screening for. We are open to someone early in their career and to someone with many years behind them. What we look for is depth and judgement on experimental data. We do not hire people into boxes. This role will stretch past its description, sometimes into the lab and sometimes into conversations beyond the team. Early hires here are expected to pick up what is in front of them. Must have ● Building and running production data and ML pipelines, ideally on scientific or lab data, including data modelling, validation and reproducible, versioned workflows. ● Handling the specifics of biological data: plate layouts, sample and reagent lot lineage, and protein and DNA construct sequences with the standard tools for working with them. ● Biostatistics for experimental data, including experimental design, replicates and controls, curve fitting, and separating batch effects from biology. ● Statistical process control and anomaly detection, so assay drift and instrument variability are caught early. ● Data visualisation for people outside your team, presenting results with their uncertainty and QC so they can understand and check them themselves. ● Fluency in Python and its scientific stack, including pandas, NumPy and SciPy, and in working with coding agents. ● SQL and relational schema design for samples, plates and results. ● Turning scientists’ questions into requirements, and writing down the assumptions behind them. Nice to have ● Hands-on analysis of instrument output from a lab, especially trace-based data such as SPR or HPLC. ● R for statistical modelling, such as dose-response fitting or mixed models for plate and batch effects. ● Containers and cloud infrastructure, such as Docker, Kubernetes and AWS. ● Working with data from LIMS, electronic lab notebooks or lab data standards. ● Current protein language models and structure prediction, such as ESM C, Boltz-2, Chai, OpenFold3 or AlphaFold 3. Why this is unusual Most assay data analysis happens far from the lab, on files someone exported weeks earlier, with little record of how the experiment ran. Here you sit next to the lab, the conditions of every run are recorded, and your analysis is delivered alongside the data. The work also changes under you. The lab starts with people running the instruments and becomes automated over time, and the analysis you first build by hand becomes the checks that run on every result. Some people find that energising; some find it outside their lane. It’s worth knowing in advance which one you are. How we work The role is based in London, at our lab and office in King’s Cross. Time in person with the scientists matters for this work. The wider team is distributed and travels, so you will work with people who are not always in the building. We work in the open. Decisions are written down and work happens in Slack. The whole company meets once a week at the start of the week, and there is a regular offsite. Each person owns their area and makes the call inside it, and we will expect that of you early rather than late. UK benefits are 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10% employer contribution, and Bupa private health cover. More is added as the team grows. The team you will join You will report to the intelligence lead. You will also work closely with the founders and with the protein characterisation scientists whose data you will analyse. We are a small, elite team, weighted towards science and software. You will be the first person on the intelligence team whose focus is the analysis and ML infrastructure behind our results. Our process Our process has four stages. A short screening call about the role and the practicalities. A behavioural interview about how you work and what you value, run from the same template for every candidate. A technical stage built on a real analysis problem from our lab, not a puzzle. You spend a few hours writing up how you would approach it, using the tools you would use on the job, coding agents included, with a short note on the decisions you made. We care about judgement more than hours, so a focused answer beats an exhaustive one. We then go through it with you in person. Then references, aimed at whatever we still want to understand. If you are not sure whether you are a fit, apply anyway. We would rather read it and decide. We are an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions on merit, scope-fit, and the strength of the working relationship we expect to build with each hire. Applications welcome from candidates of any background. title: Stage en Communication Insights Analyst & Social Listening
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a>&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>Qui sommes-nous:</strong></p> <p>Burson, leader mondial de la communication, a pour mission de créer de la valeur pour ses clients par la gestion de leur réputation. Grâce à notre expertise, nos technologies de pointe, nos solutions d'intelligence artificielle et notre créativité, nous anticipons les risques en temps réel, identifions les insights générateurs de préférence et d'engagement, et accompagnons la transformation et la réussite de nos clients. Nous réinventons la réputation pour en faire un véritable atout concurrentiel. Burson est le gardien de votre réputation, le partenaire qui vous guide dans un environnement complexe.</p> <p>En rejoignant Burson, vous intégrez une communauté mondiale d'experts à la pointe de l'innovation.</p> <p>Burson fait partie du groupe WPP (LSE/NYSE : WPP), spécialiste de la transformation créative. Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/"> bursonglobal.com</a> et suivez-nous sur <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">et Instagram</a>.</p> <p><strong>En savoir plus sur le rôle:</strong></p> <p>Stage conventionné à pourvoir à partir de février 2027.</p> <p><strong>Missions :</strong></p> <p>Au sein de l’équipe Lab IA &amp; Data de Burson France, vous contribuerez à des missions variées pour des clients de divers secteurs d’activité, en exploitant notamment des outils et des méthodologies&nbsp;propriétaires basés sur l'intelligence artificielle ou intégrant des composants IA&nbsp;:</p> <ul> <li>Veille réputationnelle et reporting quotidien</li> <li>Analyse des conversations en ligne&nbsp;(tendances, produits, marques, entreprises, etc.)</li> <li>Benchmark de communication&nbsp;(concurrentiels, tendances, social media, etc.)</li> <li>Conduite d’études et analyses&nbsp;(analyse quantitative et qualitative, recherche d’insights, élaboration de pistes stratégiques)</li> <li>Décryptage et cartographie de débats/sujets (arguments, acteurs en présence, évaluation de la sensibilité, etc.)</li> <li>En new bizz, analyse qualitative sur un marché, une marque ou une problématique</li> </ul> <p>Vous serez formés aux outils et méthodologies de l’agence, incluant nos plateformes basées sur l'IA.</p> <p><strong>Profil recherché :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Étudiant(e) en communication, sociologie, sciences humaines, lettres, sciences politiques – Master 1 ou 2. Les candidats au profil purement data analyst ne correspondent malheureusement pas à nos attentes pour ce poste.</li> <li>Curiosité pour les réseaux sociaux et les enjeux d’opinion</li> <li>Forte appétence pour la recherche, l'analyse de données et l’IA</li> <li>Bonne culture générale</li> <li>Qualités rédactionnelles, esprit de synthèse et rigueur</li> <li>Français courant et bon niveau en anglais</li> </ul> <p><strong>Notre engagement :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Stage professionnalisant avec encadrement personnalisé, vous permettant de travailler avec des outils de pointe intégrant l'IA</li> <li>Suivi régulier avec votre tuteur/tutrice</li> <li>Retours constructifs sur vos missions</li> <li>Découverte des différentes facettes du métier d'insights analyst, enrichies par les dernières innovations en IA.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Rémunération et avantages :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Gratification : 750€/mois</li> <li>Télétravail possible et éligibilité à la prime de télétravail (10€/mois)</li> <li>Forfait mobilité durable (45,40€/mois)</li> <li>Prise en charge des repas au restaurant d’entreprise (reste à charge de 3,70€)</li> <li>1 jour de RTT par mois</li> <li>Accès aux offres du comité d’entreprise (cinéma, culture, sport…)</li> <li>Prime de cooptation</li> <li>Récupération des heures supplémentaires</li> </ul> <p><strong>Votre place est chez Burson :</strong></p> <p>Notre vision est de faire de Burson la référence en matière de formation pour les professionnels de la communication créative et les leaders de demain. Nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant où les collaborateurs motivés et ambitieux peuvent développer leurs compétences, étendre leur réseau et élaborer des stratégies innovantes pour les plus grandes marques. Notre engagement envers le développement de nos talents se traduit par des opportunités de formation, des programmes de mentorat avec des leaders du secteur, et une culture d'entreprise stimulante et inclusive qui encourage la collaboration et l'innovation. Nous avons également mis en place des programmes de reconnaissance et de fidélisation pour nos meilleurs talents. Nous investissons dans nos collaborateurs car nous sommes convaincus que leur réussite est aussi la nôtre.</p> <p>Chez Burson, nous sommes une agence d'apprenants permanents. Nous savons que l'excellence en créativité et en communication exige une compréhension fine et nuancée. C'est pourquoi nous recherchons des collaborateurs talentueux de tous horizons et de toutes cultures. Ces talents sont essentiels pour concevoir des idées audacieuses, favoriser un dialogue constructif, créer des expériences enrichissantes et stimuler l'innovation pour nos clients. Votre point de vue unique, votre talent, fait de vous une #BursonPerson.</p> <p>En cliquant sur « Soumettre la candidature », vous nous transmettez les informations saisies. Avant de le faire, veuillez consulter notre politique de confidentialité en matière <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">de recrutement. </a>Les candidats résidant <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">en Californie. </a>sont invités à consulter notre politique de confidentialité californienne pour le recrutement. Ce document détaille l'utilisation de vos données personnelles lors de votre candidature et explique comment les mettre à jour ou les supprimer.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our &nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Senior Customer Success - EMEA
raw.description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Success Team and help us keep delivering value to our customers in EMEA. You'll be based in Europe and work remotely. You will be the trusted advisor to a portfolio of strategic customers and will own their success and satisfaction throughout their journey with Filigran. You will work closely with Support, Sales, and Product teams to connect technical delivery with each customer's business goals.

💼 Your Responsibilities

Strategic account ownership

  • Own the customer experience across the full lifecycle (kickoff, onboarding, adoption, training, and renewal) and be the primary point of contact between the customer and Filigran

  • Manage complete account and success plans based on each customer's business objectives, and run Quarterly Business Reviews

  • Build trusted, strategic relationships with key decision makers at EMEA customers to understand their business vision and objectives, and find opportunities for optimization and expansion

  • Use your knowledge of the customer's region and sector to drive success planning, track current and future adoption, and how it creates value for the customer

Product expertise and advisory

  • Become an expert in the XTM Suite modules (OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenCRQ and XTM One), including the technical details and best practices of each, so you can guide customers to the right solutions

  • Help customers learn more about the XTM Suite modules by sharing Filigran's product roadmap and making them aware of new products

Value and growth

  • Document and quantify the value customers get through business outcomes, ROI and impact metrics, and use it to build strong internal business cases for continued and expanded investment

  • Identify and support upsell and cross-sell opportunities in partnership with Sales

  • Track success metrics and use data to guide customer strategy and engagement

Delivery and collaboration

  • Coordinate with internal teams to resolve and escalate customer issues quickly and effectively

  • Work with Customer Support Engineers and Customer Platform Architects to keep communication and delivery smooth on deployment and support tickets

  • Collect customer feedback and share it internally to improve product and service quality

  • Travel occasionally to meet customers and attend company events

🤝 Who You'll Work With

  • You will report to the Manager of Customer Success EMEA

  • You will work closely with Customer Support Engineers (CSEs), Customer Platform Architects (CPAs), Sales, Product and Engineering

  • You will partner with regional teams to serve a diverse customer base

  • You will work across functions to keep customer satisfaction and retention high

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management or a similar client-facing role in cybersecurity, ideally in Threat Intelligence, Exposure Management, or Security Validation

  • Based in Europe, with experience supporting national and regional customers

  • Proven experience building relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers, and running business reviews (QBRs or EBRs)

  • A track record of building success plans and showing customer value in business terms (outcomes, ROI) to support renewals and expansion

  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to work with platforms such as OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenCRQ and XTM One (training available)

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities change: you adapt quickly and keep quality high

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

  • Comfortable in a remote, async-first culture

  • Experience with CRM and CSM tools, customer journey tracking, and success metrics

  • Fluency in English

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

title: Account Executive Manager | SMB | French Market (Paris)
description: À propos de Lexroom Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Notre plateforme décompose chaque question juridique en sous-questions précises, puis mobilise des agents spécialisés pour explorer en parallèle les codes, jurisprudences, doctrines et textes européens. Chaque source est minutieusement analysée, les liens implicites entre principes sont identifiés, et toutes les informations sont synthétisées dans un rapport structuré, avec chaque affirmation soigneusement sourcée. Ce qui, auparavant, demandait une semaine à une équipe se réalise désormais pendant une pause café. Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, afin que les avocats et les directions juridiques puissent se concentrer sur l'essentiel. Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale en France, et nous cherchons la personne qui va structurer et faire grandir l'équipe d'Account Executives. Pourquoi rejoindre Lexroom ? Un produit qui tient ses promesses : nos démos sont impactantes et convainquent dès la première session, pas besoin de six mois de POC. Un marché en pleine effervescence : tous les cabinets français recherchent une solution IA, et les usages sont encore à inventer. Un avantage concurrentiel fort : vous ne vendez pas un assistant IA de plus, mais une approche radicalement nouvelle que les prospects n'ont jamais vue. Un vrai rôle de bâtisseur : vous définissez les standards, les process et la culture commerciale de l'équipe dès le départ. Vos responsabilités Piloter le revenu outbound SMB : objectifs d'ARR, couverture de pipeline, taux de conversion, durée de cycle, ACV, gestion rigoureuse des remises, prévisions fiables. Manager et coacher une équipe d'AE full-cycle : 1:1 hebdomadaires, revues de pipeline, coaching sur les appels, stratégie de deals, plans d'amélioration concrets. Construire la machine outbound : segmentation ICP, découpage des territoires, stratégie de sourcing des comptes, prospection multicanale (téléphone, email, LinkedIn), standards de cadence et suivi activité → résultats. Recruter, onboarder et faire monter en compétence les AE, avec un plan de ramp-up et des jalons clairs. Gérer la performance : attentes claires, rituels hebdomadaires (WBR), diagnostic des causes (compétence, motivation, territoire, message) et action rapide en cas de sous-performance. Collaborer avec le Marketing (campagnes, contenus, événements), les Partenariats (canaux locaux, KOLs) et le Produit (remontée des insights terrain). Garantir la discipline process et outils : CRM irréprochable, séquences rigoureuses, reporting fiable. Les faits avant les impressions. Profil recherché Expérience confirmée en management commercial outbound SMB dans le SaaS B2B, avec une équipe d'AE full-cycle atteignant régulièrement ses objectifs. Expertise terrain : vous savez vous-même lancer des séquences, faire du cold call et enseigner une prospection qui convertit. Mindset de coach : vous identifiez rapidement les écarts de performance et coachez de façon structurée (écoute d'appels, scorecards), pas avec des discours de motivation génériques. Profil data-driven : à l'aise avec la funnel math (activité → meetings → démos → essais → closing), le forecast et la couverture de pipeline. Maîtrise des outils : CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), outils de séquençage et d'automatisation, Sales Navigator, et une vraie exigence sur la qualité des données. Français natif, anglais courant (clientèle francophone, équipes internes internationales). Intérêt pour le droit : une expérience dans le secteur juridique ou des services professionnels est un plus, mais pas indispensable. Ce que nous offrons Rémunération totale cible (OTE): 110 000 – 130 000 € brut annuel Equity Mutuelle Alan, titres-restaurant, accès Wellpass (sport et bien-être) Travail hybride, bureaux à Paris Team retreats et off-sites Processus de recrutement Entretien Talent Acquisition : motivation et parcours. Entretien avec le hiring manager : expérience de management et approche commerciale. Business case : construction d'un plan outbound et gestion d'une situation de performance. Entretien final : valeurs et culture. Offre. Compensation: €110K – €130K • Offers Equity • €110K – €130K • Offers Equity Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Federal and highly regulated organizations trust Valiantys to help them maximize the potential of Atlassian solutions and reach their goals. You will operate at the intersection of client strategy, technology transformation and commercial growth, building trusted relationships with senior executives, identifying where Valiantys can create meaningful business impact and mobilizing the right expertise from across our organization to make it happen. Monitor portfolio performance and adjust priorities based on data, market signals and customer engagement. Share insight, best practices and relevant market intelligence with the wider sales organization.   What you need to be successful We are looking for an enterprise seller with a strong record of building and closing significant consulting and professional services business with more than 10 years of experience minimum.  You will bring most of the following: A proven track record of winning complex, high-value professional services, consulting or transformation engagements within enterprise organizations. Strong experience growing strategic accounts and creating substantial new revenue within existing client relationships. The ability to engage credibly with C-suite and senior executive stakeholders, combining commercial confidence with intellectual curiosity. Experience creating opportunities where no formal requirement or RFP previously existed. Strong commercial judgment across pricing, scope, margin, contracting, negotiation and deal structure. The ability to navigate complex organizations, political environments and multi-stakeholder buying processes. Experience orchestrating multidisciplinary teams around large pursuits. Strong forecasting, pipeline management and opportunity qualification discipline. Experience within technology consulting, digital transformation, enterprise service management, ITSM, cloud, DevOps, AI transformation or the Atlassian ecosystem would be highly valuable. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to align consultants, delivery teams, partners and executives around a shared opportunity. Fluent in English and in French If you are ready to develop strategic accounts, achieve ambitious goals, and make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.   Why Valiantys? Valiantys is a fast-growing, international and entrepreneurial organization at the intersection of technology, consulting and business transformation. raw.title: Strategic Account Director
raw.description:
About Valiantys 

Valiantys transforms how organizations work by delivering expert solutions that increase enterprise and team agility. Valiantys unlocks the full value of Atlassian’s System of Work, helping customers revolutionize product development, streamline enterprise service management (ESM), and accelerate cloud transformation. Federal and highly regulated organizations trust Valiantys to help them maximize the potential of Atlassian solutions and reach their goals. More information about Valiantys is available at www.valiantys.com.
 

Job summary

Valiantys is looking for a Strategic Account Director to accelerate growth across our most important enterprise clients and prospects.

This role is a senior, services-led growth position for a commercially ambitious leader who can create opportunity at executive level, shape complex transformation agendas and convert them into significant consulting, professional services and long-term managed services relationships.

You will operate at the intersection of client strategy, technology transformation and commercial growth, building trusted relationships with senior executives, identifying where Valiantys can create meaningful business impact and mobilizing the right expertise from across our organization to make it happen.

Your mandate is clear: open doors, create demand, expand strategic relationships and build substantial, sustainable services revenue.

Your impact

Strategic Accounts

For senior sales professionals who are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders, navigating complex organizations and expanding strategic customer relationships over time.

You will build trusted executive relationships, identify transformation priorities, create long-term account strategies and grow the value Valiantys delivers across a customer organization. 

What you will do

Strategic account leadership

  • You will think like the CEO of your accounts.

    That means understanding each client’s strategy, organization, technology landscape, investment priorities, stakeholders and competitive dynamics and translating that intelligence into a deliberate growth strategy.

    You will build and execute account plans that answer three fundamental questions:

    • Where can Valiantys create the greatest value?

    • Who do we need to influence to make that happen?

    • How do we turn that value into sustainable commercial growth?

    You will develop relationships across multiple levels of the client organization, create executive sponsorship, uncover new buying centers and build a strong pipeline of opportunities capable of materially growing each account.

Selling outcomes, not capacity

  • The strongest candidates will understand that sophisticated services sales is not about selling consultants, days or technical resources. It is about selling change and business outcomes.

    You will lead discovery around the client’s most important challenges and ambitions, working with Valiantys’ consulting and technical experts to turn those conversations into propositions that have clear strategic relevance and measurable value.

    Whether the opportunity involves enterprise transformation, ITSM/ESM, cloud, DevOps, platform strategy, AI, operating-model change or managed services, you will ensure the conversation begins with the client’s desired outcome, not the technology.

Orchestrating Valiantys

  • Complex services opportunities are won as a team.

    You will act as the commercial orchestrator for your accounts, bringing together the best of Valiantys across consulting, solution architecture, delivery, customer success, managed services and executive leadership.

    You will create clarity around the client’s ambition, establish a compelling win strategy and ensure our teams are aligned around the outcome we are trying to achieve.

    You will also work closely with Atlassian and our broader partner ecosystem, building strong field relationships and turning platform opportunities into larger transformation and services engagements.

    Your objective is not simply to participate in opportunities. It is to shape them.

Bring commercial discipline

  • Maintain accurate forecasting, qualification and opportunity management throughout the sales cycle.

  • Apply MEDDPICC or a similar methodology to create clarity, momentum and accountability.

  • Contribute to strategic account planning, regional strategy and commercial reporting.

  • Monitor portfolio performance and adjust priorities based on data, market signals and customer engagement.

  • Share insight, best practices and relevant market intelligence with the wider sales organization.

 

What you need to be successful

We are looking for an enterprise seller with a strong record of building and closing significant consulting and professional services business with more than 10 years of experience minimum. 

You will bring most of the following:

  • A proven track record of winning complex, high-value professional services, consulting or transformation engagements within enterprise organizations.

  • Evidence of consistently delivering against ambitious services revenue and bookings targets.

  • Strong experience growing strategic accounts and creating substantial new revenue within existing client relationships.

  • The ability to engage credibly with C-suite and senior executive stakeholders, combining commercial confidence with intellectual curiosity.

  • The ability to move comfortably between strategic business conversations and the commercial detail required to get complex deals signed.

  • Experience creating opportunities where no formal requirement or RFP previously existed.

  • Strong commercial judgment across pricing, scope, margin, contracting, negotiation and deal structure.

  • The ability to navigate complex organizations, political environments and multi-stakeholder buying processes.

  • Experience orchestrating multidisciplinary teams around large pursuits.

  • Strong forecasting, pipeline management and opportunity qualification discipline.

  • Experience within technology consulting, digital transformation, enterprise service management, ITSM, cloud, DevOps, AI transformation or the Atlassian ecosystem would be highly valuable.

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to align consultants, delivery teams, partners and executives around a shared opportunity.

  • Fluent in English and in French
If you are ready to develop strategic accounts, achieve ambitious goals, and make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.
 

Why Valiantys?

Valiantys is a fast-growing, international and entrepreneurial organization at the intersection of technology, consulting and business transformation. You will work with experienced specialists who care about the quality of the outcome—not just the signature of the contract.

What we offer

  • An international, multicultural team and a genuinely European scope.

  • A flexible telework program.

  • Personal dental plan and health insurance fully funded by Valiantys.

  • Choice of PC or Mac.

  • Training time and budget to support your development.

Ready to create momentum?

If you are looking for a role where you can combine enterprise selling, strategic thinking and real customer impact, we would like to hear from you.

Whether your strength is expanding strategic accounts or opening new enterprise relationships, you will have the opportunity to shape markets, build meaningful partnerships and directly influence the growth of Valiantys and our customers.

Great salespeople create opportunities. Exceptional ones create momentum.

raw.title: Confirmed / Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Jobexit)
raw.description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte

 
Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, la squad Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage.
 
Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi au-delà du simulateur, en allant vers la gestion de cabinet d’avocat à travers plusieurs langues.
 
Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !
 
A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)
 
 

Les missions 🛠
  • Apporter de la compréhension et de l’automatisation autour des activités administratives et commerciales des avocats.
  • Générer automatiquement des documents administratifs propres aux dossiers de l’avocat.
  • Tirer parti de la jurimétrie et des simulations existantes pour apporter du contexte et des suggestions personnalisées autour d’une simulation de rupture de contrat de travail.
  • Étudier le développement d’un chatbot spécialisé sur la plateforme Jobexit.
  • Collaborer avec différents types de profils (ingénieurs, product managers, product designers, juristes) pour identifier de nouveaux axes de développement produit.
  • Participer à la diffusion interne et à la consolidation de nos bonnes pratiques dans le chapter ML ; contribuer à l’élaboration de notre stratégie Engineering.
  • Faire monter en compétence les autres ingénieurs de l’équipe.

    • Le profil idéal 👀
  • Une expérience significative en termes de construction de produits reposants sur des modèles de machine learning, de classification, de résumé, de génération de contenu, etc.
  • Une bonne connaissance du machine learning et en particuliers des modèles de deep learning.
  • Une capacité à délivrer rapidement des prototypes dans un environnement product-centric.
  • Un fort intérêt pour les sujets d’intelligence artificielle.
  • L’envie d’identifier, d'analyser, et d'intégrer en production les dernières avancées scientifiques dans le domaine.
  • Une bonne maîtrise du développement Python, avec un focus sur la construction d’algorithmes.
  • La maîtrise de la langue française et anglaise.

    • Les à côtés du poste 👁
  • Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras à un de nos chapters transverses, en l’espèce du chapter Data Science.
  • Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour :
  • 🤝 Partager des connaissances : suivit de l’état de l’art, revue de papiers scientifiques, amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques, etc.
  • 🎯 Proposer des évolutions : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre.
  • Tu participeras également au 👩‍💻 recrutement : tous les contributeurs individuels rencontrent des candidats à l’occasion de tests techniques ou d’entretiens.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)
     
     
    Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater !
    Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.
    Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !
     
    Diversité & inclusion
    Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement.
    Nous nous engageons à mettre en place tous les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir un environnement de travail adapté a chacun et chacune

title: Alternant·e Growth Marketing Manager | Thiga Academy
description: Alternance · Paris 9e · Télétravail · rythme d’alternance souhaité 3 semaines entreprise / 1 semaine école    Thiga en 30 secondes :  Thiga est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en IA et en digital. Nous accompagnons les plus grands groupes et scale-ups françaises : Decathlon, Doctolib, AXA, ManoMano, Mirakl, Disney, Leboncoin et une centaine d'autres. Nous sommes 200, majoritairement à Paris. Thiga Academy, c'est notre organisme de formation. On y forme les équipes produit (Product Managers, Product Owners, Designers, Product Leaders) et celles qui veulent le devenir : product management, product discovery, leadership produit, et IA appliquée au produit. En inter-entreprise comme en intra, on transmet ce que nos consultants pratiquent chez nos clients tous les jours   Pourquoi ce poste :  L'Academy forme chaque année 2000 professionnels et son offre est solide. Le problème : aujourd'hui, elle ne communique presque pas. Peu de contenu, peu de présence, une notoriété très en dessous de ce que le catalogue mérite. C'est une page blanche côté growth, et c'est exactement ce qui rend le poste intéressant. On cherche quelqu'un pour construire, mesurer et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition de l'Academy à partir de zéro : quels canaux, quels messages, quel funnel, avec quels résultats. Pas pour décorer le catalogue, pour le remplir. Ce que tu vas faire 🖇 1. Construire et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition, avec le Head of Marketing & Events Structurer le tunnel d'acquisition de bout en bout : quels canaux amènent du trafic, ce qui convertit en lead, ce qui déclenche l'inscription Tester des canaux et des formats en continu (LinkedIn organique et payant, email, SEO, partenariats, salons) et couper vite ce qui ne marche pas Créer et itérer les landing pages du catalogue et des sessions, pensées pour convertir dès le premier jet et retravaillées à partir de la donnée Mettre en place les séquences email dans HubSpot : nurturing, relances, réactivation des contacts dormants, avec un test A/B sur les objets et les CTA Accompagner le lancement des nouvelles formations avec un plan d'acquisition dédié, pas seulement un plan de com Créer les supports nécessaires au tunnel avec Figma (catalogue, plaquettes, brochures) en gardant en tête qu'un support existe pour convertir, pas pour exister Représenter l'Academy sur des salons et événements, avec un objectif de leads qualifiés en sortie, pas juste de présence 2. Mesurer, analyser, arbitrer Le nerf du poste. Sans mesure, pas de growth, juste du marketing qui se raconte des histoires. Suivre les KPIs qui comptent à chaque étape du tunnel : trafic, taux de clic, taux de conversion en lead, taux de conversion en inscrit, coût d'acquisition par inscrit, taux de remplissage des sessions Construire les dashboards HubSpot qui donnent une vision claire de ce qui marche, canal par canal, campagne par campagne Identifier où le tunnel fuit et proposer les hypothèses à tester pour colmater Faire remonter les résultats au Head of Marketing & Events pour arbitrer les prochains messages, offres et canaux, avec des chiffres, pas des impressions 3. Faire vivre la marque et la communauté qui nourrissent le funnel L'acquisition ne marche pas sans contenu ni preuve sociale. C'est le carburant du tunnel. Poser la ligne éditoriale et la faire vivre : posts LinkedIn, articles, newsletters, formats courts autour du product et de l'IA Animer la relation avec les alumni et la communauté d'apprenants : témoignages, cas concrets, un bouche-à-oreille qu'on peut transformer en canal d'acquisition mesurable L'IA n'est pas une option chez nous , c'est la pierre angulaire de notre façon de travailler, et on attend de toi que tu aies cette fibre. Concrètement, tu t'appuieras sur l'IA à chaque étape : générer et itérer des variantes de copies avec Claude, produire des visuels avec Nano Banana et Figma, des teasers avec HeyGen, ou transformer une transcription Granola en article et en carrousel LinkedIn. C'est ce qui te permet d'avancer vite et de tester dix fois plus d'hypothèses qu'une équipe classique. La stack que tu vas pratiquer 🧰 Le growth marketing moderne, c'est une combinaison d'intuition testée par la donnée, de vitesse d'exécution et de bons outils au bon moment. LLM et agents : Claude (Pro et Code), Gemini Génération visuelle et audio : Nano Banana, Adobe Firefly, ElevenLabs, HeyGen Marketing ops : HubSpot (CRM, marketing hub, workflows), Luma, Phantom Buster Prise de notes et capitalisation : Granola, Notion AI Vibe coding (en bonus, pour les profils qui veulent aller plus loin) : Lovable, Cursor pour bricoler des micro-outils internes Tu n'as pas besoin de tout maîtriser à l'arrivée. On attend une vraie curiosité et l'envie de pratiquer, pas un CV exhaustif. Le profil que nous recherchons 🌟 Formation : école de commerce ou de communication, en M1 ou M2, idéalement avec une spécialisation marketing, growth ou entrepreneuriat Pratique IA personnelle prouvée : tu as un side project, un compte ChatGPT ou Claude que tu utilises tous les jours, un workflow Make ou n8n que tu as construit, un agent custom, un blog assisté par LLM, un repo GitHub, ou n'importe quoi qui démontre que l'IA est dans ta vie. Réflexe growth : tu penses en funnel avant de penser en campagne, tu formules des hypothèses avant de produire, et tester puis mesurer te vient plus naturellement que produire pour produire Appétence data : Excel ou Google Sheets n'ont pas de secret pour toi, et l'idée de creuser un dashboard pour comprendre pourquoi un taux de conversion a bougé t'intéresse plus qu'elle ne t'ennuie Fibre communication : tu sais écrire pour être lu, tu as déjà animé une page, un compte ou une communauté Rigueur opérationnelle et sens du détail : tu sais qu'une séquence email qui commence par « Bonjour {prénom} », ça fait tâche, et qu'un A/B test mal cadré ne prouve rien Sensibilité business : tu comprends les concepts MQL, CAC, NPS, et tu sais qu'une belle campagne ne vaut rien si elle ne remplit pas les sessions Au-delà des hard skills, on recherche surtout quelqu’un de curieux, volontaire, débrouillard et qui n’a pas peur de proposer des nouvelles idées ! Fonctionnement quotidien en équipe avec les autres Head of (Content, Design) et le CMO Cadre de travail : bureaux 23 rue Taitbout (Paris 9), équipe marketing de 8 personnes Rémunération : grille légale alternance, transparente dès l'entretien Le process 🎢 Envoie ton CV, un lien vers un side project ou portfolio (même bricolé).
