title: Head of Customer Experience & Trust
description: <p><em><strong>This role can be based in our Rotterdam HQ or in our Cergy office.</strong></em></p> <p>We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.</p> <p>With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.</p> <p>We're looking for a<strong> Head of Customer Experience &amp; Trust </strong>to be the guardian of the tenant experience on our unified platform. As we consolidate the HousingAnywhere and Studapart operations teams, you will lead a multi-site support and trust organisation across Rotterdam and Cergy and own not just how we respond to our users, but the content, policies, and safeguards that shape their experience before they ever contact us.</p> <h2>Your role and impact</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead the shift to AI-first support:</strong> Make our AI agent the first point of resolution for tenants and landlords, across all channels. Report on automated resolution, quality and CSAT as seriously as on human SLAs, and prioritise support needs in the Ops automation roadmap.</li> <li><strong>Set the direction for our AI agent:</strong> Decide what the AI agent should resolve, what it must never do, and when it hands over to a human. Set its resolution and quality targets, and approve how our policies are explained. Work with the Ops Project Manager, who owns the knowledge base and runs the AI agent day to day.</li> <li><strong>Redesign the team around AI:</strong> Lead the CS Team Managers in Cergy and Rotterdam and, through them, a team of experts with local market knowledge. Evolve roles so agents spend their time on complex, sensitive and high-value cases, and on training and supervising the AI. Build one standard way of working across both sites.</li> <li><strong>Own the rules:</strong> Own T&amp;Cs and service policies with Legal, and approve how they are explained to users. The Ops Project Manager turns them into help content for users, our AI agent and our teams.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Get ready for high season:</strong> Build data-based capacity plans that factor in automation rates, and prepare each peak well ahead: staffing, AI agent coverage, and processes. Select, onboard and manage BPO partners to absorb peak volumes, with clear quality standards, SLAs and costs. Work with the Quality &amp; Training Manager to train BPO agents and monitor their quality, and with the Ops Project Manager to give them the knowledge base and tools they need.</li> <li><strong>Raise the quality bar:</strong> Use the Voice of Customer insights and AI-assisted quality reviews led by the Quality &amp; Training Manager to drive change in your teams and raise quality of service and all departments.</li> <li><strong>Own Trust &amp; Safety, AI-assisted:</strong> Steer the content integrity and T&amp;S vertical through the dedicated Team Lead in Rotterdam, who manages both sites. This covers listing moderation, fraud prevention and dispute handling. Use AI-based detection and moderation so we always display real content from real users, with human judgement on the final call.</li> <li><strong>Own the cancellation flows:</strong> All cancellation assessment and resolution flows sit with you, including post-cancellation retention and relocation. Automate what’s simple and keep a human touch where tenants need it most.</li> <li><strong>Protect our reputation:</strong> Protects the platform’s reputation on Trustpilot and Google, and acts on Voice of Customer insights from the Quality &amp; Training Manager.</li> </ul> <h2>Your profile</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Professional experience:</strong> 5+ years in customer operations, with 2+ years leading multi-team or multi-site support organisations, ideally in a marketplace, travel or high-volume consumer platform.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on AI deployment:</strong> You have deployed an AI support agent in production, not just piloted one. You can show how you improved its resolution rate and quality over time.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge and content ownership:</strong> You have shaped T&amp;Cs, help content or service policies with Legal and Product. You write rules that both people and AI can follow.</li> <li><strong>Trust &amp; safety literacy :</strong> You have owned or worked hands-on with moderation, fraud prevention and dispute resolution, and can balance protection with conversion.</li> <li><strong>Data-driven:</strong> You run on SLAs, CSAT, automation and cancellation metrics. You know how to hold quality through seasonal peaks.</li> <li><strong>Peak and partner management:</strong> You have prepared support teams for seasonal peaks, and have selected and managed BPO partners, holding them to the same quality standard as your own team.</li> <li><strong>Change leadership:</strong> You lead through team leads and have taken a team through a change in roles driven by automation, keeping people engaged along the way.</li> <li><strong>Responsible AI:</strong> You know where AI should stop and a human should take over. You are familiar with GDPR and EU AI Act transparency requirements for customer-facing AI.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluent English required; French a strong plus.</li> </ul> <h2>What's in it for you</h2> <ul> <li>Position based in our Cergy office (hybrid working policy), with visits to HQ in Rotterdam.</li> <li>Executive status with 218 workdays/year (with RTT days off).</li> <li>50% transport costs covered.</li> <li>70% health insurance coverage.</li> <li>Meal vouchers.</li> <li>Contribution to fitness membership costs.</li> <li>Christmas gift vouchers.</li> <li>Team-building events and much more!</li> </ul> <p>Read more about our France-based teams <a href="https://www.welcometothejungle.com/en/companies/studapart">here</a>.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Financial Crime Lead
description: What is Finary? Money is broken: most people’s wealth sits in products they did not choose, with fees they cannot see. We are putting a private banker in everyone’s pocket, with the same quality of advice for a €10K saver and a €10M client. Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1M people now track their wealth with us. Finary AI turns that context into a plan, and our investment products and in-house wealth advisors (Finary One) make it real. Why now? AI makes this possible, and 3 things make it hard to copy: years of per-user financial data that no public dataset holds, a brand that brings in half of our new users through our own channels, and licences (PSAN, Investment Firm, MiCA) we secured before they became mandatory. We raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator and Speedinvest. Founders and leaders from Qonto, Photoroom, Bitpanda, UBS and Wise also invested. What we offer We’re 70 builders with real ownership from day 1, tier-1 salary and equity, and offices in central Paris with hybrid remote. Our culture is direct and built on radical candor. AI is a real bar here: everyone has rebuilt how they work around it. Read more about our values here . The opportunity More than 1M people track and grow their wealth with Finary. In 2021, when a simple registration was enough to offer crypto in France, we chose to build fully regulated. Today Finary is a crypto-asset service provider under MiCA, an investment firm, a payment institution and an insurance broker. Very few European platforms hold that combination. Our compliance team is organised by role, not by product: compliance officer, AML, senior advisory and control. Each role covers every licence. Reporting to our Head of Compliance, who is our AML/CFT officer, you'll work alongside our AML analyst and take ownership of the framework that protects our clients and our licences, with most of our exposure in crypto. What you'll do Lead the AML/CFT framework: procedures, client risk classification, detection rules and tools (screening, blockchain analytics, Travel Rule), calibrated on our own data. Investigate and decide the hard cases: enhanced reviews of individuals and companies (ownership chains, financial statements, flows), on-chain investigations, decisions on suspicion. Draft and file suspicious transaction reports, and act as deputy TRACFIN declarant and correspondent. Handle screening and asset freezing: PEP, sanctions and adverse media hits, list updates. Build with AI: design and tune the agents and rules in our back-office tool that prepare files and clear first-level reviews, and keep the decision on suspicion human. Work with Ops, Care, Product and our outsourced review team so that AML decisions are clear, fast and fair to the honest majority of our clients. What we're looking for You've spent 6 to 8 years in AML/CFT in financial services, including hands-on work at a crypto-asset service provider (PSAN/CASP). You've drafted and filed suspicious transaction reports with TRACFIN yourself. You investigate on-chain: you use blockchain analytics tools and you know the Travel Rule and self-hosted wallets. You hold a certification in on-chain analysis (Chainalysis CCI, CCCA or CRC, or a TRM Labs or Elliptic equivalent) and a Travel Rule certification (Notabene NB-TRFC or equivalent). You work with data and AI every day: you query data yourself and you already use AI in your reviews or investigations. This is a must, not a plus. You decide on evidence, you keep weak signals in proportion, and you explain your decisions clearly. You prioritise a growing queue by risk without missing a legal deadline, and you move the framework forward at the same time. Fluent French and professional English. This role is not for you if you'd rather stay on onboarding checks, you prefer advising to deciding, or you need a large financial crime department and mature tools before you can start. You don't tick every box? Apply anyway if you've done the core of the job: investigating cases, deciding them and filing the reports. Interviews Interviews with French-speaking candidates are held in French. As an international company, we expect a working level of English, which we test during the screening call. title: Product Designer - Paris
description: As a Product Designer, you'll work on the H Platform, where our users create and run agentic AI workflows powered by our models. Nobody has written the playbook for designing these experiences yet. Our next stage is making the platform truly useful for its users and levelling it up, in design as much as in technology, and you'll build the product experiences that deliver real value in organisations. At H Company, we believe AI should take action in the real world, and our mission is to make agentic AI genuinely useful for large organisations. We're pioneers in computer use: our own vision-language models power agents that see, click and type their way through the software businesses already run, with no integrations or rebuilds, and we own the whole stack, from research and models to the products built on top of them. What you'll be doing Talking to our users constantly to understand their needs and figure out what will make the platform truly useful for them. Turning those insights into research and explorations, looking at problems from different angles before settling on a direction. Picking the right tool for each task: a Figma design, a prototype, or a small PR when a quick change is the fastest way to ship. Testing what you build with users, measuring its impact (A/B testing, user interviews, users daily use data...) and iterating quickly based on what you learn. Shaping the roadmap together with the whole team, engineers and PMs alike. Who you'll work with The role sits in our Product team, which is responsible for product direction, strategy and design. You'll join the product designer who owns design and UX today, and work closely with product, engineering and forward deployed engineers. What we think it takes Above all, we want someone who cares deeply about users, has great product taste and can explain it, moves fast while keeping quality high, leaves their ego at the door and welcomes feedback. Likely a good fit if you Have 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer at tech companies. Have excellent UX, UI and interaction design skills, and can make complex, technical flows, like building and running AI agent workflows, feel simple and intuitive. Have a portfolio that shows your latest work. Have hands-on experience running user tests and A/B tests. Know when a proven solution is good enough and when a problem deserves something new. Have designed complex data or ML/AI-driven products: you know how to make complex systems understandable and how to design for AI behaviour that isn't always predictable, building trust and keeping users in control. Are comfortable in technical discussions: you can dig into constraints and trade-offs with engineers and ramp up quickly on technical topics to discuss them with our researchers and more technical engineers. Are fluent in Figma. Can work within a design system and contribute to it. Stronger still if you Have designed platforms: complex B2B web or desktop software used by professionals, whether that's tools to build and run workflows, big data and analytics software, operational dashboards or other data-dense interfaces. Are curious about code and AI in your design workflow. Every design team is still figuring out how AI changes the way we work, and we're no different, so we'd love someone who has started experimenting, whether by prototyping in code, building small tools or bringing AI into their process, and who wants to keep exploring with us. If you match most of this but not every point, apply anyway. We care far more about how you think, your curiosity and your care for users than a perfect match. How we hire Four stages: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute portfolio review, a 60-minute design interview in person at our Paris office, and a closing 30-minute conversation. The portfolio review and design interview are built around your own work and how you design. Please apply with your CV and a link to your portfolio showing your latest work. title: Junior AI Engineer
description: Who we are Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce. Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants. For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible. Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel. We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label. Today, Lemrock is already: 100M+ conversations per month 150+ brand clients a $100B market structuring at high speed The role The product works, clients renew, and every month millions of people talk to AI agents running on our infrastructure before they buy. That traffic produces a unique dataset, and we want to get even more out of it: uncover the hidden patterns in how shoppers search, compare and decide, and use them to keep improving our recommendation algorithms and campaign performance. As our Junior AI Engineer, this is applied work: you dig into the data, find what drives performance, ship the improvement to production and measure the result. You also maintain and improve our agents in production, and build the Claude Code skills that automate operational work and save time for the business team. You work directly with our Founding AI Engineer and the founders, alongside product and engineering. Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

The role

The product works, clients renew, and every month millions of people talk to AI agents running on our infrastructure before they buy. That traffic produces a unique dataset, and we want to get even more out of it: uncover the hidden patterns in how shoppers search, compare and decide, and use them to keep improving our recommendation algorithms and campaign performance.

As our Junior AI Engineer, this is applied work: you dig into the data, find what drives performance, ship the improvement to production and measure the result. You work directly with our Founding AI Engineer and the founders, alongside product and engineering.

With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You’ll join AdManager, the team behind everything advertisers touch in Vibe: campaign setup, performance reporting, creatives management, integrations, payments, and account management. This role exists because AdManager’s scope is growing fast, and we need senior engineering capacity to keep shipping complex initiatives without dropping the bar on quality or reliability. Three reasons to take it: you’ll own work on a product surface advertisers use every day, you’ll work with a team that runs on high ownership and low process, and you’ll be somewhere speed and technical excellence are expected to go together.

What You’ll Do

Build & Ship Advertiser-Facing Product

  • Design core AdManager features for campaign setup, reporting, and creatives management

  • Ship complex advertiser-facing initiatives from concept to production

  • Own initiatives from start to finish with minimal supervision

  • Turn ambiguous product requirements into clear technical plans

  • Define delivery milestones with product managers and engineers

Fullstack Engineering

  • Build advertiser-facing interfaces in Next.js, React, and TypeScript

  • Design scalable APIs and services for advertiser workflows

  • Design database schemas that keep campaign data clean and queryable

  • Maintain the PostgreSQL systems behind reporting and campaign data

  • Apply rigorous testing and code review across the codebase

Reliability & Production Ownership

  • Instrument every new feature with monitoring, logging, and alerting before launch

  • Debug production issues in the systems you build

  • Lead incident response and postmortems for your own systems

  • Improve codebase conventions and developer experience beyond your assigned tickets

Product & Technical Judgment

  • Propose better technical solutions to advertiser workflow problems

  • Challenge weak assumptions with pragmatic, data-backed alternatives

  • Use AI-assisted development workflows to speed up delivery

  • Protect correctness across a shared codebase

What You Need

  • You’ve shipped production-grade fullstack software with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL

  • You’ve owned projects end-to-end, from problem definition through long-term maintenance

  • You have strong backend fundamentals in API design, data modelling, and system architecture

  • You’ve owned production systems, including monitoring, debugging, and incident response

  • You can break ambiguous initiatives into technical plans and manage dependencies

  • You move fast without sacrificing reliability or maintainability

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in CTV, campaign management, or customer-facing SaaS products

  • Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design and Test-Driven Development

  • Experience building AI-powered products

  • Experience improving developer experience or internal engineering tooling

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

For candidates in France, the pay range for this role is €74,000 - €114,000 (base salary). We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You’re building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We’re in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here’s exactly what to expect: no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter screen — 30 min. We’ll share context; you’ll share yours.

  2. Manager interview — Meet the person you’d work with directly.

  3. Technical Interview — A real problem, not a trick. We’ll work through it together.

  4. Team Interview — Meet the team members you'd work with directly.

  5. Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we’re holding a consistent, high bar.

  6. Offer — Fast. We don’t let good decisions sit.

  7. Reference checks — Two calls, handled with discretion.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’UFR S2I sur le Campus de Brest.   Projet FLOWATT Le projet FLOWATT, dans le cadre duquel s’inscrit cette étude, vise à déployer et exploiter six hydroliennes dans les forts courants marins du Raz Blanchard, en Normandie. Au-delà de la production d’énergie, FLOWATT a pour objectif d’évaluer le potentiel du Raz Blanchard pour le déploiement de fermes hydroliennes à plus grande échelle. Cette évaluation repose notamment sur une caractérisation précise de la ressource, une estimation fine du productible et une meilleure compréhension des impacts environnementaux. Pour répondre à ces enjeux, le projet combine mesures in situ, modélisation numérique et essais expérimentaux afin de fournir les connaissances nécessaires à la préparation des futurs déploiements commerciaux, tout en contribuant à la réduction des coûts de production et à la limitation des impacts sur l’environnement marin. Dans ce contexte, la caractérisation de l’état de mer constitue un enjeu important, notamment dans une zone soumise à des courants très intenses. La présente étude s’intéresse ainsi aux données de radar HF acquises depuis fin 2017, ainsi qu’à celles qui seront nouvellement enregistrées dans le cadre du projet TidalRace. Le système, de technologie WERA, est réparti sur deux sites distants d’environ 5 km au Cap de la Hague et fonctionne à deux fréquences, 13,5 MHz et 24,5 MHz. Les acquisitions sont réalisées en continu, à raison de quatre mesures par heure, 24 h/24 et 7 j/7, sur une emprise couvrant l’ensemble du Raz Blanchard. Cette couverture temporelle et spatiale offre ainsi une opportunité unique de suivre l’évolution des états de mer dans des conditions hydrodynamiques particulièrement contraintes. L’exploitation de ces données nécessite toutefois d’adapter les méthodes de traitement aux conditions de forts courants. L’objectif des travaux est donc d’améliorer les algorithmes existants et, si nécessaire, d’en développer de nouveaux afin de restituer de manière fiable les spectres d’énergie des vagues en fréquence et en direction, ainsi que les paramètres moyens associés. (2018). Les méthodes développées seront ensuite évaluées à partir des mesures in situ et des modélisations numériques. title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (Power Electronics)
description: Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness. As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, you will turn our power electronic modules into a robust, compact and safe product. You will design how the SiC-based power modules, magnetics, busbars and cooling come together into one unit, working closely with our power electronics, magnetics and thermal engineers. Instead of handing your designs over for someone else to build, you take them all the way: you calculate them, build and assemble the prototypes yourself in our workshop, and take the design from first prototype to a product ready for series production. This role is for you if… you've designed the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems and know your way around creepage, clearance and insulating plastics. You back your designs with solid calculations, and you're as comfortable with a screwdriver in the workshop as with CAD at your desk. This role isn't for you if… your experience is in classic mechanical design only, such as gears, gearboxes or pumps, or you prefer to stay at your desk while someone else builds your prototypes. It's also not a fit if you need technicians for assembly or established processes before you can start. Key Responsibilities Design the mechanical integration of power electronic modules into the SST: enclosures, holders, fixtures and jigs, and interfaces to the busbar system, with a modular design approach. Model and design electro-mechanical parts and assemblies, including plastics, sheet metal, insulation systems, magnetic components and cooling system interfaces. Ensure electrical safety through the design on both the medium-voltage and low-voltage side: creepage and clearance distances, CTI and material selection, electrical isolation and sealing. Design for manufacturing, assembly and test from the first concept, working with suppliers on processes such as injection molding, sheet metal and machining. Own the DFMEA for your designs and drive the resulting actions into the design. Validate designs with structural FEA, including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis, before they are released for production, and correlate the results with test data. Build and assemble prototypes and test assemblies hands-on in our workshop, together with the engineering team, using additive manufacturing where it speeds things up. Collaborate with other engineers to take designs from concept through prototype to series production. Share your expertise and support other engineers on best practices in mechanical engineering. Qualifications Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field. 4+ years of full-time industry experience in mechanical design, with a focus on the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems. Proven experience applying DFM and DFA to your own designs, with parts and assemblies that made it into production. Hands-on experience leading or actively contributing to DFMEAs. Strong experience with structural FEA (e.g. ANSYS), including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis. You set up the models yourself and use the results to drive design decisions. Solid knowledge of creepage, clearance, CTI, insulation coordination and electrical safety (e.g. IEC 60664-1, IEC 62477-1), ideally up to medium voltage. Solid experience designing with polymers/plastics, ideally for electronics integration. Proficiency in 3D CAD (e.g. SolidWorks), GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis. Hands-on experience building and assembling prototypes in a professional setting. Experience with environmental, reliability and safety standards for power delivery products. Basic understanding of electrical design fundamentals; familiarity with PCBAs and PCBA components. Strong organization, written and verbal communication skills. Fluent English; German is a plus. Eligible to work in Switzerland (Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit). The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland. Nice to Have Experience with industrialization: taking hardware from prototype to series production and designing with series production in mind from the start (tooling such as injection molds, supplier involvement, cost and process capability). Experience with high-volume manufacturing and automated assembly processes. Experience with additive manufacturing (e.g. SLA, SLS, FDM) for prototypes, fixtures and jigs, ideally including insulating or flame-retardant materials. Experience with PFMEA, DFT and DFR. Experience with insulation design for medium voltage, including partial discharge. Experience with liquid cooling integration or CFD. Benefits Equity + competitive salary. Unique technology and market opportunity – design the hardware of a new product category for the energy transition. Hybrid work with flexible working times. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

title: IT Operations Engineer
description: <p>At IMC, technology is not a department; it’s at the heart of everything we do. Developed in-house, our innovative software makes millions of trading decisions daily, and we win by making better and faster decisions than our competition. Our on-site IT Support team helps us move at a higher pace and quality each day, from hands-on support for end users to configuring and automating our systems to scale our support capabilities.</p> <p>In this fully on-site position, you are the first person people come to with any IT issue, whether it’s a MacBook, a SaaS application, identity and access management, or hardware and AV. You support our growing Zug office and act as first- to third-line support. Our environment is predominantly macOS and cloud-based, with a small Windows footprint. You’ll work across a wide range of SaaS and custom systems. To succeed and grow, you take ownership, work autonomously, and keep improving an IT environment that runs smoothly and is ready to scale.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Your Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>First-to-third line support for our users, mainly on macOS.</li> <li>Managing and supporting our end-user platform, including Microsoft 365, Okta (SSO, MFA, lifecycle management), Slack and the Atlassian stack (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management).</li> <li>Device management and patching: Jamf for macOS and Intune for phones, including enrollment, configuration profiles, app deployment and compliance.</li> <li>Onboarding and offboarding, including account provisioning, access management and device setup.</li> <li>Installing, setting up and servicing hardware and peripherals, including laptops, monitors, printers, and audio and video conferencing systems.</li> <li>Troubleshooting, escalating and documenting network and connectivity issues.</li> <li>Automating repetitive tasks and keeping knowledge base articles and runbooks in Confluence up to date.</li> <li>Organizing and performing desk moves, room setups and physical equipment moves.</li> <li>Everything else that keeps us moving.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree in an ICT-related field (BSc level ideally), or an equivalent qualification such as Informatiker/in EFZ.</li> <li>At least one year of experience in a similar role in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Strong macOS knowledge and hands-on experience with JAMF (Pro).</li> <li>Experience with Microsoft 365 administration and Intune; working knowledge of Windows.</li> <li>Familiarity with Okta or a similar identity provider (SSO, SCIM, MFA).</li> <li>Experience administering or supporting Slack and the Atlassian suite.</li> <li>Scripting experience (Bash, Zsh, Python or PowerShell) is a plus, and so is Linux experience.</li> <li>Excellent troubleshooting and diagnostic skills, with the ability to solve problems creatively and proactively.</li> <li>Willingness to take on physical tasks such as desk moves and room setups.</li> <li>A strong drive to grow (at IMC we are committed to helping with that).</li> <li>You work autonomously, with a sense of urgency, and prioritize based on business needs.</li> <li>Available and willing to work on-site full-time in Zug.</li> <li>Proficient in written and spoken English; German is a plus.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p><em>IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Backend Software Engineer - Indexing
description: About us: DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry. Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage. Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it. About the Role: We’re looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join our team and take meaningful ownership from day one. You’ll work closely with smart, driven, and genuinely fun people who are passionate about tackling the complex challenges involved in building a high-performance product at scale. Our indexing system is the backbone of our search engine, processing queries over hundreds of millions of documents in fractions of a second. Building and maintaining these indices within tight time and resource constraints requires highly performant, scalable software. To achieve this, we rely on modern technologies in distributed and parallel computing, database systems, and cloud platforms. You’ll leverage the strengths of these technologies to meet demanding throughput and latency requirements. Your responsibilities will include: Design, develop, and maintain efficient, scalable backend services using modern tools and frameworks Take ownership of core components of our indexing infrastructure Collaborate with other engineers to define, design, and ship new features Optimize performance and scalability across our data processing pipelines Integrate with third-party data providers and effectively use their APIs Review code and contribute to a high standard of code quality and maintainability Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives You're a great fit if you: Have a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Have 2+ years of experience as a Backend Software Engineer, ideally in a scale-up or fast-growing environment Have strong experience with concurrent and parallel programming and understand how to write correct, efficient code under load Are highly proficient in Python, our primary backend language. Solid experience with Rust or Go is also very welcome, even if Python isn't your strongest language yet Have solid experience working with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) Are comfortable with modern web architectures and cloud platforms Enjoy solving complex problems and thinking about performance at scale Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a collaborative team Take ownership and can work independently when needed Have experience with information retrieval or search systems (nice to have) What you can look forward to: Location: Office 5min walking distance from Zurich central station, where we primarily work on site Collaborative and supportive work environment Potential for professional growth and advancement within the company Ownership and ability to impact the company, product, and culture At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

About us:

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

About the Role:
We’re looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join our team and take meaningful ownership from day one. You’ll work closely with smart, driven, and genuinely fun people who are passionate about tackling the complex challenges involved in building a high-performance product at scale.

Our indexing system is the backbone of our search engine, processing queries over hundreds of millions of documents in fractions of a second. Building and maintaining these indices within tight time and resource constraints requires highly performant, scalable software. To achieve this, we rely on modern technologies in distributed and parallel computing, database systems, and cloud platforms. You’ll leverage the strengths of these technologies to meet demanding throughput and latency requirements.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, develop, and maintain efficient, scalable backend services using modern tools and frameworks

  • Take ownership of core components of our indexing infrastructure

  • Collaborate with other engineers to define, design, and ship new features

  • Optimize performance and scalability across our data processing pipelines

  • Integrate with third-party data providers and effectively use their APIs

  • Review code and contribute to a high standard of code quality and maintainability

  • Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Have 2+ years of experience as a Backend Software Engineer, ideally in a scale-up or fast-growing environment

  • Have strong experience with concurrent and parallel programming and understand how to write correct, efficient code under load

  • Are highly proficient in Python, our primary backend language. Solid experience with Rust or Go is also very welcome, even if Python isn't your strongest language yet

  • Have solid experience working with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL)

  • Are comfortable with modern web architectures and cloud platforms

  • Enjoy solving complex problems and thinking about performance at scale

  • Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a collaborative team

  • Take ownership and can work independently when needed

  • Have experience with information retrieval or search systems (nice to have)

What you can look forward to:

  • Location: Office 5min walking distance from Zurich central station, where we primarily work on site

  • Collaborative and supportive work environment

  • Potential for professional growth and advancement within the company

  • Ownership and ability to impact the company, product, and culture

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

title: Engineering Lead (m/w/d)
description: Engineering Lead (m/w/d) - Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände 80–100 % · Zürich · Festanstellung · per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung Über MaxBrain MaxBrain AG wurde 2016 in der Schweiz gegründet und ist ein führender Anbieter für digitale Lernlösungen mit aktuell 12 Mitarbeitenden. Mit einer innovativen Kombination aus Learning Management System (LMS) und Learning Experience Plattform (LXP) übersetzt MaxBrain Lernstrategien in ganzheitliche, digitale Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände. Renommierte Bildungsinstitutionen sowie zukunftsorientierte Unternehmen vertrauen auf die Expertise von MaxBrain, darunter Bildungspartner wie Digicomp, WEKA und Talentus, führende Berufsverbände wie SwissAccounting, Electrosuisse und die OdA beider Basel sowie Marktführer wie Zweifel Chips & Snacks, InfoGuard, BLT Basellandschaft Transport und Baumann Koelliker und viele mehr. Worum es geht Als Engineering Lead übernimmst du die technische Verantwortung für MaxBrain. Du führst unser Entwicklungsteam über DevOps, Frontend, Backend und Mobile hinweg und bist dabei selbst technisch nah dran – du gibst Architektur, Qualität und Tempo vor. Gemeinsam mit dem CEO und dem Product Lead trägst du die Umsetzungsverantwortung für die Roadmap und stellst sicher, dass die Plattform verlässlich und in hoher Qualität betrieben und weiterentwickelt wird. Eine zentrale Rolle spielt das Shaping unserer AI-Capabilities: KI ist dabei fest in die ganze Plattform eingebaut, nicht nur in einzelne Funktionen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Entwicklungsteam in Kroatien und dem Team in Zürich zusammen, berichtest direkt an den CEO und hast die Perspektive, Teil der Geschäftsleitung zu werden. Deine Aufgaben Technische Führung: Du leitest und entwickelst ein kleines aber erfahrenes Entwicklungsteam von SysAdmin, DevOps, Frontend, Backend und Mobile und schaffst eine Kultur von Ownership, Qualität und Tempo. Lieferverantwortung für die Roadmap: In enger Abstimmung mit dem CEO und dem Product Lead sorgst du dafür, dass die Roadmap verlässlich, termingerecht und in hoher Qualität ausgeliefert wird. AI-Capabilities weiterentwickeln: Du prägst, wie KI unser Lern Ökosystem spürbar wirksamer macht – ganz im Sinne von «Make Learning Matter». Du führst die KI Transformation in der Entwicklung und dem Betrieb der Plattform, um diese neue Technologie gewinnbringend für MaxBrain einzusetzen. Technische Projektleitung: Du berätst unsere Kunden und unser Customer Success Team zu Themen wie Integrationen und Automatisierungen und verantwortest entsprechende Projekte von A bis Z aus technischer Sicht. Architektur und technische Exzellenz: Du gestaltest die Architektur zusammen mit den Entwicklern, triffst fundierte Technologieentscheidungen und hältst Skalierbarkeit, Sicherheit und Wartbarkeit hoch. CISO/ISO-27001: Du betreust die jährliche ISO-Rezertifizierung und verantwortest den Bereich Datensicherheit für MaxBrain. Dein Profil Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung von Entwicklungsteams, idealerweise über DevOps, Frontend, Backend und Mobile hinweg, kombiniert mit eigener technischer Exzellenz. Fundierte Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb skalierbarer B2B-SaaS-Architekturen, inklusive Schnittstellen, Integrationen und Automatisierungen für anspruchsvolle Grosskunden. Praktische Erfahrung mit modernen KI-/ML-Technologien und Freude daran, KI-Capabilities von der Idee bis in die Produktion zu bringen. Du denkst in Lieferverantwortung: Du priorisiert pragmatisch, triffst klare Architekturentscheidungen und bringst Releases verlässlich und in hoher Qualität auf die Strasse. Du arbeitest eng mit Produkt und Business zusammen und übersetzt Kundenbedürfnisse in tragfähige technische Lösungen. Du bist vertraut mit Symfony/PHP, Go, Angular, MySQL und Docker/Kubernetes. Du findest es spannend, neue Technologien kennenzulernen und verstehst es, sie gewinnbringend einzusetzen. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (C1-C2); unser Entwicklungsteam arbeitet auf Englisch. Weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus. Was wir bieten Eine Kultur, die lebt, was wir verkaufen: Wir lernen selbst jeden Tag dazu, teilen Wissen offen und nehmen «Make Learning Matter» auch intern ernst. Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und direkte Verantwortung für die Entwicklung, Architektur und den Betrieb der SaaS-Plattform. Die Chance, unsere KI-Strategie von Grund auf mitzugestalten und in wertstiftende Produkte zu übersetzen. Kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Austausch mit dem CEO und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Customer Success und Entwicklung. Die Perspektive, dich mit wachsender Verantwortung in der Geschäftsleitung weiterzuentwickeln. Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit grundsätzlicher Erreichbarkeit während der Kernarbeitszeiten. Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit mindestens zwei Tagen pro Woche in unserem Büro in Zürich. Fünf Wochen Ferien sowie ein fixes Weiterbildungsbudget inklusive bezahlter Weiterbildungszeit. title: Product Lead (m/w/d)
description: Product Lead (m/w/d) - Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände 80–100 % · Zürich · Festanstellung · per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung Über MaxBrain MaxBrain AG wurde 2016 in der Schweiz gegründet und ist ein führender Anbieter für digitale Lernlösungen mit aktuell 12 Mitarbeitenden. Mit einer innovativen Kombination aus Learning Management System (LMS) und Learning Experience Plattform (LXP) übersetzt MaxBrain Lernstrategien in ganzheitliche, digitale Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände. Renommierte Bildungsinstitutionen sowie zukunftsorientierte Unternehmen vertrauen auf die Expertise von MaxBrain, darunter Bildungspartner wie Digicomp, WEKA und Talentus, führende Berufsverbände wie SwissAccounting, Electrosuisse und die OdA beider Basel sowie Marktführer wie Zweifel Chips & Snacks, InfoGuard, BLT Basellandschaft Transport und Baumann Koelliker und viele mehr. Worum es geht Lernen ist für uns kein Pflichtprogramm. Lernen ist ein Motor für Entwicklung, Performance und Kultur. Unsere Vision: MaxBrain wird die People-Development-Plattform für mittelständische Unternehmen. Das Fundament steht: geschäftskritische Lern-Ökosysteme für Bildungsinstitute und Verbände. Darauf bauen wir auf. Künftig bildet MaxBrain nicht nur Lernmassnahmen ab, sondern auch die Prozesse, die bestimmen, wer was, wann und weshalb lernt: Skill Management, Performance Management, Compliance, Onboarding und Karrierepfade. KI ist dabei kein Zusatzmodul, sondern unterstützt in jedem Schritt: beim Finden passender Inhalte, beim Abgleich von Skills und bei Lernwegen, die sich automatisch anpassen. Deine Rolle: Als Product Lead machst du aus dieser Vision eine Strategie und aus der Strategie ein Produkt. Du trägst die strategische Produktverantwortung für die MaxBrain SaaS-Plattform. Du entwickelst sie konsequent vom Markt, von Kundenproblemen und vom wirtschaftlichen Nutzen her. Du setzt Prioritäten, reduzierst Komplexität und schaffst Klarheit. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Entwicklungsteam in Kroatien und dem Team in Zürich zusammen, berichtest direkt an den CEO und hast die Perspektive, Teil der Geschäftsleitung zu werden. Deine Aufgaben Produktvision und -strategie: Du entwickelst die Vision von MaxBrain als People-Development-Plattform weiter und übersetzt sie in eine klare Produktstrategie. Du legst fest, welche Probleme wir für welche Kunden lösen und welche nicht. Markt und Positionierung: Du kennst den L&D- und HR-Tech-Markt im DACH-Raum. Du beobachtest Wettbewerb und Trends und schärfst gemeinsam mit dem CEO unsere Positionierung. Fokussierte Roadmap: Du leitest aus Strategie und Kundenbedürfnissen eine nutzenorientierte Roadmap ab. Du setzt klare Prioritäten und sagst auch Nein. Du reduzierst Komplexität, statt Feature-Listen zu verwalten. Produktmanagement: Du erkennst und validierst Kundenbedürfnisse und triffst daraus klare Produktentscheidungen. Du konzipierst Features im Design-Thinking-Prozess, verantwortest das funktionale und das UX-Design und schreibst klare User Stories. Lernen als strategische Infrastruktur: Du verankerst Lernen in den HR-Prozessen, die bei unserer Kundschaft täglich laufen: Onboarding, Compliance, Jahresgespräche und Weiterbildung. Integrationen in HR-Systeme wie Personio, Abacus oder Microsoft machen die Plattform zur Infrastruktur statt zur Insel. KI als Hebel: Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge intensiv für Research, Spezifikation, Prototyping und Design. So deckst du mit einem schlanken Setup viel ab und entscheidest schneller und besser. Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit Engineering, Sales und Customer Success. Du schaffst Alignment über Prioritäten und Nutzen. Dein Profil Du hast einen nachweisbaren Track Record im L&D-, EdTech- oder HR-Tech-Umfeld. Du bringst 5–7 Jahre Erfahrung im Product Management, Product Design oder einer vergleichbaren Produktrolle mit, idealerweise mit einem komplexen B2B-SaaS-Produkt. Du hast eine Produktstrategie entwickelt und umgesetzt. Du hast Produkte oder grössere Features von der Discovery bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung geführt. Du kennst Corporate Learning und People Development. Erfahrung mit LMS, Skill- und Performance-Management oder angrenzenden HR-Produkten ist ein grosses Plus. Du denkst strategisch und arbeitest hands-on. Du sprichst gerne direkt mit Nutzern, strukturierst komplexe Probleme und arbeitest selbstständig mit Design- und Prototyping-Tools wie Figma. 80–100 % · Zürich · Festanstellung · per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Über MaxBrain

MaxBrain AG wurde 2016 in der Schweiz gegründet und ist ein führender Anbieter für digitale Lernlösungen mit aktuell 12 Mitarbeitenden. Mit einer innovativen Kombination aus Learning Management System (LMS) und Learning Experience Plattform (LXP) übersetzt MaxBrain Lernstrategien in ganzheitliche, digitale Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände.

Renommierte Bildungsinstitutionen sowie zukunftsorientierte Unternehmen vertrauen auf die Expertise von MaxBrain, darunter Bildungspartner wie Digicomp, WEKA und Talentus, führende Berufsverbände wie SwissAccounting, Electrosuisse und die OdA beider Basel sowie Marktführer wie Zweifel Chips & Snacks, InfoGuard, BLT Basellandschaft Transport und Baumann Koelliker und viele mehr.


Worum es geht

Lernen ist für uns kein Pflichtprogramm. Lernen ist ein Motor für Entwicklung, Performance und Kultur.

Unsere Vision: MaxBrain wird die People-Development-Plattform für mittelständische Unternehmen. Das Fundament steht: geschäftskritische Lern-Ökosysteme für Bildungsinstitute und Verbände. Darauf bauen wir auf. Künftig bildet MaxBrain nicht nur Lernmassnahmen ab, sondern auch die Prozesse, die bestimmen, wer was, wann und weshalb lernt: Skill Management, Performance Management, Compliance, Onboarding und Karrierepfade. KI ist dabei kein Zusatzmodul, sondern unterstützt in jedem Schritt: beim Finden passender Inhalte, beim Abgleich von Skills und bei Lernwegen, die sich automatisch anpassen.

Deine Rolle: Als Product Lead machst du aus dieser Vision eine Strategie und aus der Strategie ein Produkt. Du trägst die strategische Produktverantwortung für die MaxBrain SaaS-Plattform. Du entwickelst sie konsequent vom Markt, von Kundenproblemen und vom wirtschaftlichen Nutzen her. Du setzt Prioritäten, reduzierst Komplexität und schaffst Klarheit.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Entwicklungsteam in Kroatien und dem Team in Zürich zusammen, berichtest direkt an den CEO und hast die Perspektive, Teil der Geschäftsleitung zu werden.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Produktvision und -strategie: Du entwickelst die Vision von MaxBrain als People-Development-Plattform weiter und übersetzt sie in eine klare Produktstrategie. Du legst fest, welche Probleme wir für welche Kunden lösen und welche nicht.

  • Markt und Positionierung: Du kennst den L&D- und HR-Tech-Markt im DACH-Raum. Du beobachtest Wettbewerb und Trends und schärfst gemeinsam mit dem CEO unsere Positionierung.

  • Fokussierte Roadmap: Du leitest aus Strategie und Kundenbedürfnissen eine nutzenorientierte Roadmap ab. Du setzt klare Prioritäten und sagst auch Nein. Du reduzierst Komplexität, statt Feature-Listen zu verwalten.

  • Produktmanagement: Du erkennst und validierst Kundenbedürfnisse und triffst daraus klare Produktentscheidungen. Du konzipierst Features im Design-Thinking-Prozess, verantwortest das funktionale und das UX-Design und schreibst klare User Stories.

Integrationen in HR-Systeme wie Personio, Abacus oder Microsoft machen die Plattform zur Infrastruktur statt zur Insel.

title: Senior Mechanical Designer
description: You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure? You want to take ownership of designs that move from early prototypes to reliable serial production? Join CDDS to turn ambitious engineering concepts into parts and assemblies that can be manufactured, assembled, and delivered at scale. CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones, including Mavics, FPV racers, and fast fixed wings. Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while countering threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments. Tasks Your Mission We are looking for an experienced Senior Mechanical Designer with strong expertise in injection molding and a track record of taking products from prototype to serial production. You will work hands-on in CAD, developing and refining parts and assemblies with manufacturing and assembly requirements built into the design from the start. You will collaborate directly with injection molding suppliers, resolve manufacturability issues, and follow your designs through tooling, first samples, and production ramp-up. Working closely with our mechanical, electrical, and production teams, you will help ensure that our designs perform in the field and can be produced and assembled consistently. We are looking for someone who have practical manufacturing knowledge and follows a design through until it works on the assembly line. Core Responsibilities Develop and refine 3D CAD models, assemblies, and production drawings, with a strong focus on injection-molded plastic parts. Take designs from functional prototypes through design release, tooling, initial production runs, and serial production. Apply design for manufacturing and assembly principles to improve part quality, reduce cost, and simplify production. Work directly with injection molding suppliers on feasibility reviews, tooling constraints, design changes, and first-sample evaluation. Design for efficient, repeatable assembly, including accessible fastening, clear part orientation, and mistake-proofing methods such as poka-yoke. Requirements Your Profile You bring practical experience turning designs into manufactured products. You understand how CAD decisions affect tooling, part consistency, assembly effort, and cost. You are comfortable discussing details with suppliers and working alongside the people who assemble your designs. At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in mechanical design or product development. Demonstrated experience taking at least one product or significant assembly from prototype through production ramp-up. Proficiency in professional 3D CAD software and the creation of complete manufacturing drawings. Strong understanding of injection molding constraints, including draft angles, wall thickness, ribs, bosses, undercuts, shrinkage, and warpage. Ability to work autonomously and collaborate closely with engineering, suppliers, and production teams. BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field, a Swiss apprenticeship as a Konstrukteur/in EFZ, or an equivalent relevant qualification. Nice-to-Have Proficiency in SolidWorks. Experience with composite materials and their manufacturing and assembly processes. Experience designing assembly fixtures, inspection aids, or production tooling. Familiarity with machining, sheet metal fabrication, and additive manufacturing. Experience with drones, robotics, aerospace, or other products combining mechanical and electronic systems. Benefits Why CDDS Direct impact on a mission-critical technology shaping Europe’s security landscape. Fast-moving startup environment with high ownership. Work with a highly technical, ambitious, and hands-on team. Real-world testing, deployments, and customer demonstrations. Attractive compensation. Details Location: Zürich Hardbrücke, on-site Start date: ASAP Environment: High-impact deep-tech startup working on real deployments If you are interested in the position, please apply via the application form. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&amp;D.</p></div><h2>The role</h2> <p>Nebius Token Factory&nbsp;is looking for&nbsp;scientists who can turn frontier&nbsp;LLM and VLM&nbsp;inference bottlenecks into research&nbsp;questions, conduct&nbsp;rigorous experiments, and&nbsp;translate their findings into production capabilities. You will own focused&nbsp;research and optimization&nbsp;projects, write strong code, and produce prototypes, publications, and technical artifacts&nbsp;that engineers can&nbsp;build on.</p> <p>Your research will span quantization, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, and model/runtime co-optimization, alongside inference engines and distributed inference architectures. You will investigate how these approaches interact, evaluate their trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost per token, and work with engineering teams to bring promising results into production.</p> <h2>Your responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Lead&nbsp;research projects in efficient LLM and VLM&nbsp;inference, from hypotheses and experiments through ablations, prototypes, and production handoff.</li> <li>Develop and evaluate methods spanning quantization, quantization-aware training (QAT),&nbsp;distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.</li> <li>Build prototypes&nbsp;using&nbsp;PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks,&nbsp;and collaborate&nbsp;with MLEs and platform engineers to&nbsp;turn them into&nbsp;production components.</li> <li>Research LLM request routing and scheduling strategies, including cache-aware load balancing and prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD). and GPU budgets.</li> <li>Work&nbsp;with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to&nbsp;select research priorities with measurable production impact.</li> <li>Share model/system&nbsp;trade-offs.</li> </ul> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>A&nbsp;PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, prototypes.</li> <li>Deep&nbsp;knowledge&nbsp;of LLMs, VLMs, transformer inference, decoding algorithms, model compression, quantization, and production-serving&nbsp;trade-offs.</li> <li>Strong CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones (Mavics, FPV racers and fast fixed wings). Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while effectively countering unauthorized or threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments. Tasks You mission We are looking for an exceptional Embedded Software Engineer – Wireless Systems to take ownership of the software connecting our ground stations and drone platforms. Our requirements go beyond what standard radio products offer. You will dig into existing software and firmware, understand the assumptions behind their design, and rework them to meet our needs. This requires someone who can navigate unfamiliar code, reason across software and hardware boundaries, and turn elusive failures into understood, tested solutions. You will work closely with our RF/electrical and software engineers, with the autonomy to make architectural decisions and the responsibility to prove them in the field. We are looking for technical depth, curiosity, and the persistence to follow a problem through - from its first symptom to a reliable fix. Core Responsibilities Investigate, modify, and extend existing radio software and firmware beyond their standard functionality. Develop and maintain embedded communication software across ground stations, radio equipment, and onboard systems. Improve communication reliability, latency, throughput, connection establishment, and recovery from interruptions. Build diagnostic tools, logging, and automated tests that make failures reproducible and improvements measurable. Own software integration and validation, from controlled lab experiments to real-world field testing. Maintain our modifications to supplier code, document architectural decisions, and work with suppliers to resolve platform limitations. Requirements Your Profile You combine strong software fundamentals with hands-on engineering judgment. Hands-on experience with embedded Linux and/or RTOS-based systems. Strong understanding of networking and communication protocols, including IP and serial interfaces. Experience investigating concurrency, timing, buffering, and resource constraints in embedded systems. A systematic approach to debugging, using tools such as debuggers, packet captures, and runtime traces. Proficiency in Python for diagnostics, tooling, and test automation. Ability to take ownership of an open-ended technical problem and carry it through implementation, testing, and field validation. MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated engineering experience. Nice-to-Have 5 years experience developing or adapting software for wireless communication systems or radio modems. Experience with networking (routing, bridging, filtering) and Linux administration. Familiarity with flight controller firmware (e.g. PX4, ArduPilot, Betaflight, iNav) and communication protocols (e.g. uXRCE-DDS, MAVLink, MSP). Benefits Why CDDS Direct impact on a mission-critical technology shaping Europe’s security landscape. Fast-moving startup environment with high ownership and substantial technical responsibility. Work with a highly technical, ambitious, and hands-on team. Real-world testing, deployments, and customer demonstrations. Attractive compensation. title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Planning & Navigation)
description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases. You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation. What You'll Work On Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites. Sensor integration driven by navigation requirements, including what ground segmentation and traversability estimation need in day, night, and challenging weather. Environment understanding: how the robot distinguishes ground from obstacles and estimates which terrain is safe and practical to traverse. Behavior prediction: anticipate how people, vehicles, and other dynamic obstacles will move, and plan routes that stay safe and efficient around them. Field reliability: reproduce failures from deployments, find the root cause, and fix it at the right layer, from sensor data and maps to costmaps, planners, and recovery behaviors. Planning under imperfect localization: plans that stay useful when the state estimate drifts and the robot must execute routes in tight or dynamic environments, working with the rest of Robot Autonomy on localization and control. Validation on real robots: logs, simulation, and repeatable field tests to verify that design choices and changes hold across routes, lighting, weather, and site layouts. New autonomy capabilities: work with the engineers building the operator application and backend so operator requests and new robot capabilities rest on a sound navigation design. The field feedback loop: work closely with forward-deployed engineers to turn site issues into bugs, design changes, and improvements to the navigation stack. Regular site visits to build a practical understanding of how robots and sensors behave in real operating conditions. Who We're Looking For We're looking for an engineer who has taken a robotics system from unreliable to dependable and takes ownership beyond individual tickets. You can explain why you made a navigation design choice and what it costs. When a robot takes a bad route, you can tell whether the planner, the map, the state estimate, or the robot's behavior is at fault, and you fix the right one. You are comfortable in the field and want to understand how robots behave in real customer environments. Your Background A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Proven track record building and deploying navigation on ground mobile robots in the real world (3+ years or equivalent depth). Hands-on experience with mobile robot navigation and path planning: route or local planning, static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, costmaps, or recovery behaviors. Understanding of how mapping and localization affect navigation, and the ability to diagnose when a planning issue is actually caused by the map, the state estimate, or robot behavior. Understanding of how lighting, weather, terrain, and sensor limitations affect perception and navigation, with experience developing or validating systems for demanding real-world conditions. Hands-on experience with robotics sensors and hardware, especially LiDAR, IMUs, and cameras. You can investigate issues across software, networking, and hardware boundaries. Experience testing and debugging navigation on physical robots using logs, visualization, simulation, and repeatable field tests. Strong ROS 2, C++, and Python skills. Clear communication of navigation and path-planning design choices and their trade-offs. Willingness to visit customer sites regularly. Nice to Have Experience with legged robots or with more than one robot embodiment. Experience with Nav2 or a comparable navigation framework. Motion prediction or planning among people and vehicles, such as trajectory forecasting or socially aware navigation. Terrain mapping and traversability methods: elevation mapping, learned traversability, or semantic segmentation for navigation. Experience with night-time or all-weather sensing, such as thermal cameras or LiDAR in rain and fog. Background in security, defence, or other safety-critical robotics deployments. What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence. Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. title: Senior Engineering Manager
description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. What you’ll do in this role: Lead, mentor and manage a team of Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers. Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing culture. Own engineering delivery for your areas of the EAP and CT platforms, from discovery through to release and operation in production. Partner with Product Managers and Designers to shape the roadmap, refine priorities, and plan and execute features and improvements. Provide technical leadership in architecture and design, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, scalable and secure. Work with engineers on decisions about tools, frameworks and approaches. Champion engineering best practices: proactive exploration AI-enabled and agentic development, code quality, testing, code review, API design, observability, documentation and secure development. Ensure quality and compliance requirements are built into how the team works. This includes data privacy and the regulatory context of healthcare. Build a culture of ownership, experimentation and continuous improvement, including healthy team rituals and retrospectives. Partner with Recruitment to attract, hire and onboard top talent. What you bring to the table: A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a solid background in backend, frontend or full stack development. 5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams. A proven track record of delivering high-quality web products and developing engineers. Hands-on familiarity with modern backend and frontend technologies. Experience with Python and Angular is a plus. A strong understanding of Agile ways of working, product development and engineering best practices. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels. A passion for working in a mission-driven organisation focused on improving patient outcomes. Experience in a regulated domain such as healthcare or life sciences or in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, is a plus.
