Delivery is predictable and transparent. The team ships valuable increments regularly, with a clear link to product goals. Code quality, test coverage and release reliability are visibly improving. Every team member has clear expectations and a development plan, and you’ve addressed any key gaps in team composition. The team works with autonomy and accountability, and collaborates well with Platform and other engineering teams. You’ve identified and started executing key technical or organisational improvements that enhance scalability and team effectiveness. You’re seen as a trusted technical and people leader, balancing strategic direction with hands-on support where needed. Our current tech stack: We are fully cloud-native on AWS. We follow a lean, API-first product development approach. Our platform services, both microservices and AI, are built in Python. Our frontends are built with Angular. We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD to EKS and Terraform for IaC, with staging/production parity, continuous deployment and Grafana for observability. Security is built in through managed secrets, SSO, dependency scanning, end-to-end encryption and periodic pen-tests. System Engineer – Machine Control
Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Senior, 8+ years of relevant experience

About us
AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase, small, and growing.

The role
You own how our tool is controlled and operated. The machine combines lasers, high-speed cameras, a nanometer-precision wafer stage and GPU-based image reconstruction. Every measurement depends on these parts working together in tight synchronization. You are the system engineer for that layer: the control architecture, the timing, the machine software, and the data path from sensor to result. You work side by side with our system engineer for the metrology hardware and with our algorithms team, and together you lead the system.

You will:

  • Own the system control architecture: machine software, control hardware, timing and synchronization, and the data path from acquisition to reconstruction

  • Translate system performance and throughput goals into requirements for control, software and compute, and keep them traceable

  • Own the timing, throughput and data budgets, and decide where time is won or lost in a measurement

  • Define and guard the interfaces between control software, hardware and algorithms, including the hardware abstraction layer

  • Define how the machine is operated: machine states, sequencing, recipes, error handling, logging and monitoring

  • Steer the software and embedded engineers on the control side: set priorities, run design reviews and resolve trade-offs

  • Set up integration and verification of the control layer, with a test strategy that keeps it reliable as the hardware changes between builds

  • Carry the machine software from lab prototype toward a production tool that runs unattended in a fab

Your profile

  • 8+ years in high-tech equipment, including several years as a system engineer, software architect or control architect for a complex machine

  • Experience with machine control in semiconductor, lithography, metrology or scientific instruments

  • Hands-on understanding of real-time and deterministic systems: hardware triggering, FPGA-based synchronization, motion control and high-rate data acquisition

  • Strong in equipment software architecture: layered designs, hardware abstraction, state machines and concurrency

  • Comfortable reading code and reviewing designs in Python and C/C++. You won’t write most of the code, but you can.

  • Strong in requirements, budgets and interface management across hardware and software

  • This is not a role in a large organization with fixed processes: you help decide how we work. You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where roles are fluid, and you are as likely to be at the lab bench debugging a trigger as in a design review.

  • A clear communicator with engineers, management and partners

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Bonus:

  • Taking machine software from prototype to production, including SEMI standards for equipment communication and automation (such as SECS/GEM) and machine safety

  • Integration with wafer handling and factory automation

  • High-throughput data pipelines or GPU computing

  • Experience with optical or imaging systems: cameras, lasers, image data

  • Model-based systems engineering or modern requirements tools

We care more about systems thinking and ownership than about a perfect match. If your title was software architect, control architect or lead engineer, but you have owned how a complex machine runs, apply anyway.

What we offer

  • Shared technical leadership of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet

  • Small team, short feedback loops, real impact on the product

  • Competitive salary for the Dutch market

integrating</li> <li>Strong cloud-native and serverless architecture on AWS, with infrastructure as code (Terraform)</li> <li>Experience with event-driven and distributed systems (Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS) description: Wil je zien wat jouw ideeën doen voor een merk waar jonge ouders dol op zijn? Bij Petite Amélie zie je meteen het resultaat van je werk. Je haalt bij ons niet alleen koffie: vanaf dag één draai je volwaardig mee in ons marketing- & e-commerceteam, met de Nederlandse en Belgische markt als jouw terrein. Over Petite Amélie Wij ontwerpen en produceren meubels, accessoires en speelgoed voor baby- en kinderkamers, en jonge ouders in heel Europa zijn er dol op. We groeien snel, met webshops in Nederland, België, Frankrijk, Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk. Vanuit ons kantoor in Weesp (15 minuten met de trein vanaf Amsterdam Centraal) werken we met zo’n 30 collega’s aan het merk. Wat ga je doen? Ons team beheert de webshops en alle online kanalen. Organische groei en sterke content staan centraal. Je kiest samen met je begeleider waar je de nadruk op legt, op basis van je leerdoelen en interesses: Influencers & samenwerkingen: je zoekt passende influencers en contentmakers in Nederland en België en neemt zelf contact met ze op. Je zet samenwerkingen op, zoals productgifting, contentdeals en campagnes, en je onderhoudt de relaties. Content & social: je maakt content voor Instagram, TikTok en Pinterest en doet community management. Campagnes & landingspagina’s: je helpt campagnes uitvoeren en bouwt en werkt aan pagina’s die converteren. Webshop & merchandising: je bepaalt mee hoe producten in de shop worden gepresenteerd. SEO & CRO: je zoekt uit waarom bezoekers wel of niet kopen, en wat we daaraan kunnen verbeteren. Data & onderzoek: je rapporteert over e-commerce-KPI’s en doet marktonderzoek naar nieuwe kansen. Aan het eind van je stage heb je echte resultaten en een eigen netwerk om te laten zien, en daarmee val je bij je volgende werkgever meteen op. Wie zoeken we? Dit heb je echt nodig: Je studeert bedrijfskunde, marketing, communicatie, economie of iets vergelijkbaars, op hbo- of wo-niveau, en je stage is onderdeel van je opleiding (met stageovereenkomst). Je bent fulltime beschikbaar voor minimaal 6 maanden, vanaf januari of februari 2027. Je woont in Nederland. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands, en je Engels is goed. Dit maakt je een goede match: Je pakt dingen zelf op, bent nieuwsgierig en denkt commercieel. Je vindt het leuk om mensen te benaderen en relaties op te bouwen. Je hebt oog voor design, interieur en esthetiek. Je werkt nauwkeurig en graag samen. Herken je jezelf niet in elk punt? Solliciteer toch. Enthousiasme en leergierigheid wegen voor ons zwaar. Stuur je CV en vertel ons kort wie je bent. Je kunt een motivatie schrijven, maar je mag jezelf ook voorstellen met een reel, story of een ander creatief format. Dat vinden we leuk, maar het is niet verplicht. Zo verloopt het: binnen een week hoor je van ons. Daarna volgt een (video)kennismaking met je toekomstige begeleider, en je hoort snel of je in januari of februari kunt starten. Vragen? Together, we build technology that makes healthcare more accessible, giving patients and healthcare professionals more space to focus on care. Our digital health solutions enable healthcare professionals to monitor patients remotely, helping people receive the right care in the right place. You will work across our mobile applications, creating reliable, intuitive and high-performing experiences for patients and healthcare professionals alike. Beyond developing and improving our apps, you will help shape our technical direction, explore new technologies and share your expertise with colleagues. You will have the autonomy to take ownership, make technical decisions and contribute beyond your immediate responsibilities, supported by Luscii's Holacratic way of working. Your role As a Mobile Developer at Luscii, you will take ownership of the development, optimisation and maintenance of our mobile applications across iOS and Android. You bring ideas to life, make well-considered technical decisions and help ensure our applications remain performant, stable, scalable and easy to maintain. You will work closely with colleagues across development, QA and support, combining hands-on engineering with technical ownership. Whether you are building a new feature, exploring a technology through a proof of concept or resolving a production issue, you will help us continuously improve the quality and usability of our digital health solutions. Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore new technologies, validate technical approaches and identify opportunities for improvement. Investigate and resolve production issues through debugging and performance analysis, covering areas such as memory management, multithreading and networking. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You have extensive experience with Kotlin and/or Swift. About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

 

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

 

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

We are looking for a Cloud Architect to shape and implement Vitestro's cloud platform with a clear, pragmatic technical direction. Our infrastructure runs on AWS and supports mission-critical, regulated medical device software. Vitestro is also realizing its first integration with Laboratory Information System (LIS) over the cloud, and delivering that connection is a core part of this role. We need someone who translates real operational and business constraints into working systems — someone whose first instinct is "what does this actually need to do, reliably and affordably," not "what's the most sophisticated way to solve this."

You will join the Platform & Connectivity team and build alongside its cloud, backend, and DevOps engineers. This is an individual-contributor technical leadership role, not a people-management position — you carry the architectural vision and build it hands-on with the team, rather than designing something for others to execute.

If you'd rather ship a solid, working solution than iterate endlessly toward a theoretically ideal one, and you have a track record of keeping cloud costs under control at scale, you'll thrive in this role.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, you get to know our cloud platform, the device connectivity and the team. You review the current architecture, its costs and its production-readiness, and identify where the biggest risks and quick wins are. You take ownership of the cloud architecture for our first LIS integration, and you agree with the team on the first architectural standards for observability, logging and infrastructure as code.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, our first LIS integration runs reliably in production, with monitoring, alerting and failure handling in place. Cloud costs are predictable and under control, and key architectural decisions and trade-offs are recorded. The team uses shared patterns instead of reinventing solutions, and is confident running production systems as we move from pre-market to post-market.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Set the technical direction for our AWS-based cloud platform and build it hands-on with the team — weighing cost, operability, and production-readiness as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts

  • Own the cloud architecture of Vitestro's first LIS integration over the cloud: secure, reliable, and traceable data exchange between our platform and the hospital laboratory

  • Choose solutions on their merits rather than defaulting to the most AWS-native option — including other clouds, self-hosted tooling, or dedicated infrastructure when that's genuinely the better fit

  • Take implementations from a working prototype to something that's production-ready — monitoring, alerting, and failure handling included. You bring experience with production systems and advise the team on how to navigate from pre-market to post-market stages.

  • Establish architectural standards and patterns so similar problems (e.g. observability, logging, data pipelines) get solved consistently instead of reinvented each time

  • Keep cloud costs in check as part of everyday engineering decisions, catching expensive mistakes before they show up on an invoice

  • Balance short-term solutions driven by business needs and deadlines against the long-term architecture: make each trade-off explicit, record it, and plan the path from the tactical fix to the durable solution

  • Diagnose and resolve production issues across the cloud platform from logs, metrics, and traces


What You’ll Bring:

  • Deep, hands-on production experience with AWS at scale — not certification-level familiarity, but real experience with what breaks and what gets expensive as usage grows

  • Proven experience running production systems end to end, from design and release through monitoring and incident response, and the ability to advise a team that is new to production

  • Genuine experience building outside an AWS-only mindset — another cloud, self-hosted/open-source alternatives, or dedicated/on-premise infrastructure — enough to make an informed trade-off, not just AWS as the only tool you reach for

  • A track record of finishing what others started: turning a partial or unstable implementation into something genuinely reliable in production

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code practice (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, or AWS CDK) as the authoritative source of environment configuration

  • Comfortable operating in a regulated, security-conscious environment where architecture decisions have compliance implications

  • Familiarity with AWS cost structure, along with the ability to factor in cost-related considerations when designing infrastructure

  • Professional English; Dutch is a plus

Nice to have:

  • Experience specifically with observability/logging platforms at scale (e.g. OpenSearch, Grafana/Loki stacks, or equivalent) — bringing an implementation to production-hardened state, not just standing it up

  • Experience in medical device, healthcare, or another regulated industry

  • Familiarity with multi-tenant, per-customer cloud architectures (e.g. isolated accounts or workloads per client/region)

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

How We Work

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

  • We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

  • We focus on execution and delivering results.

  • We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

  • We challenge ideas, not people.

  • We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

  • We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer 

  • Competitive salary including a pension plan

  • 25 days of annual leave (full-time position)

  • A high-skilled team based in Utrecht

  • Frequent out-of-work team activities and an annual company weekend away

  • A training budget

  • The chance to help shape the new niche of autonomous medical robotics

We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. 

Are you excited? 

We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! 

If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together!

Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Why Customs Matters More Than Ever</strong></h3> <p>International trade is under more pressure than ever before. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.</p> <p>That’s where we come in. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.</p> <p>Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. title: Account Executive Tender (Non-profit) & RFPs
description: In de non-profit-, overheid- en onderwijswereld draait alles om impact en vertrouwen. Het proces is gestructureerd en verloopt stap voor stap, maar tenders zijn complex en relaties zijn cruciaal. Zo'n 30% van onze commerciële inflow komt binnen via tenders en RFPs — en dat aandeel groeit. RFPs komen daarbij vaak van grotere enterprise-klanten en worden in samenwerking met andere Account Executives voorbereid en opgepakt. Veel salesmensen begrijpen dat proces onvoldoende. Ze sturen standaardproposities en hopen op het beste. Wij geloven dat het anders moet: met echte gesprekken, diep begrip van aanbestedingsdynamiek en een adviseur die meedenkt in het PvE-proces in plaats van alleen reageert op een uitvraag. Daarom bestaat deze rol. Jij bent onderdeel van het team aan tenderspecialisten die marktpartijen begeleidt van marktconsultatie tot tender tot win — en die daarna zorgt dat het contract goed landt. Jouw rol Je bouwt een sterke pijplijn van tenders en RFPs bij non-profitorganisaties, gemeenten, onderwijsinstellingen en enterprise-accounts. Je wint aanbestedingen en zorgt dat Studytube vanaf de marktconsultatie al als thought leader op de radar staat. Concreet ga je aan de slag met: Het vroegtijdig spotten van marktconsultaties (ism het Tenderteam) en het actief meedenken in het PvE-proces, zodat criteria aansluiten bij wat wij goed kunnen leveren. Thought leadership richting inkopers en beleidsmakers, zodat Studytube al vóór de formele tender een bekende en vertrouwde naam is. Het volledige tendertraject managen: van marktconsultatie, via inschrijving en EMVI-onderbouwing, tot gunning en win. RFPs bij grotere enterprise-klanten samen met andere Account Executives voorbereiden en oppakken, zodat expertise en capaciteit gebundeld worden. Het zorgvuldig managen van het contractproces na gunning, inclusief afstemming met legal over voorwaarden, aansprakelijkheid en SLA's. Het opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met opleidingsmanagers, inkopers en directieleden bij non-profitorganisaties, gemeenten en onderwijsinstellingen. Het samenwerken met sales team, tenderteam, implementatieteam, contentteam en customer success team om klanten écht succesvol te maken. What the job looks like Geen strak jaarplan, maar een dynamische agenda die meebeweegt met de tenderkalender. De ene week werk je aan een marktconsultatie, de volgende week schrijf je aan een inschrijving, ondersteun je een collega-AE bij een enterprise-RFP, of onderhandel je over een contract. Dagelijks ziet het er ongeveer zo uit: Je volgt tenderplatforms en de markt scherp en identificeert kansen al in de marktconsultatiefase. Je bouwt offertes en proposities die aansluiten bij EMVI-criteria en publieke waarden. Je beoordeelt en onderhandelt contractvoorwaarden, en schakelt waar nodig met legal. Je werkt samen met andere Account Executives aan RFPs voor grotere enterprise-klanten. Je werkt samen met interne teams zodat de klant de beste ervaring krijgt – van tender tot implementatie. Je monitort je pijplijn, stuurt bij en zorgt dat je targets realistisch maar ambitieus zijn. Who you are We zoeken geen standaard salesprofiel. We zoeken iemand die tenders en RFPs als vakgebied ziet, niet als bijzaak. Wat wél belangrijk is: Je hebt 4 tot 6 jaar ervaring in sales, bij voorkeur met tenders/RFPs in non-profit, overheid of onderwijs. Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het begeleiden van marktconsultaties en het beïnvloeden van een PvE. Je hebt affiniteit met contracten en legal processen — je bent niet bang voor voorwaarden, aansprakelijkheid en onderhandelingen (pre). Je bent een consultative seller: je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en geeft oprecht advies. Je bent relationeel sterk en bouwt liever langdurige partnerships dan snelle deals. Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en kunt goed samenwerken met verschillende teams, ook binnen een enterprise-RFP waar je met andere AEs optrekt. Je schrijft en spreekt goed Nederlands (C1-niveau) en voelt de nuance van formele communicatie in aanbestedingstrajecten. What we offer Basis van €85K op basis van 40 uur per jaar, variabel €40K = totaal OTE €125k met goede secundaire voorwaarden €1.000 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar + onbeperkt toegang tot de Studytube Academy Flexibel werken en een inspirerend kantoor aan het IJ met eigen gym 25 vakantiedagen + een extra dag op je verjaardag MacBook, telefoonvergoeding en dagelijks verzorgde lunch Een team dat écht gelooft in wat we doen en waarin je snel impact kunt maken Over Studytube Wij maken professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk, leuk en effectief. Met meer dan 300 klanten, waaronder veel non-profitorganisaties en bekende namen als Bol.com, ASR en Ajax, groeien we hard. Ons doel is duidelijk: Europa's beste platform voor leren en ontwikkelen worden. Heb je vragen over deze vacature? Stuur een mail naar ----- style="min-height: 1.7em;"> We maken graag kennis met je. description: At Studytube, we're not just another EdTech company from Amsterdam. We've taken on a big challenge: helping organisations close the skills gap and giving employees the room to grow. Our platform shows companies which skills really matter, where the biggest gaps are, and how to tackle them. But real impact takes more than a strong product — it comes from creating relevant experiences, sharp storytelling, and engagement that actually means something. That’s why we’re looking for a Solutions Engineer who bridges commercial ambition and technical-legal reality. You secure the ‘Technical Win’ in complex sales trajectories and enterprise tenders, acting as trusted advisor so every proposal is commercially winning, technically defensible and fully aligned with client needs and regulatory standards. What you will do As Solutions Engineer you own the engineering and advisory layer that turns complex customer requirements into robust, secure solutions across the full sales cycle. You are building the so-called “technical/product champion” alongside the AE in the sales process. Activities that come along with winning customers from the solution engineering perspective are: You design and configure platform solutions for complex enterprise scenarios, including deep integrations, custom roles, automations and external content sources, so every demo and proposal is tailored and technically sound. You analyse RFPs/RFIs and PvE documents, identify gaps, manage the Memorandum of Information (NVI/Q&A) process and craft high-quality qualitative narratives on topics such as security, architecture, accessibility and continuity. You lead technical deep-dives, workshops and on-site UAT sessions, remove blockers in real time and build consensus with IT stakeholders, CISOs and C-level decision makers. You’ve moved beyond standard demos into complex enterprise solution design and tender support. You have hands-on experience configuring platforms, scoping integrations, working with APIs and data models, and shipping working technical answers under tender deadlines. But real impact takes more than a strong product — it comes from creating relevant experiences, sharp storytelling, and engagement that actually means something.

That’s why we’re looking for a Solutions Engineer who bridges commercial ambition and technical-legal reality. You secure the ‘Technical Win’ in complex sales trajectories and enterprise tenders, acting as trusted advisor so every proposal is commercially winning, technically defensible and fully aligned with client needs and regulatory standards.


What you will do

As Solutions Engineer you own the engineering and advisory layer that turns complex customer requirements into robust, secure solutions across the full sales cycle. You are building the so-called “technical/product champion” alongside the AE in the sales process. Activities that come along with winning customers from the solution engineering perspective are:

  • You design and configure platform solutions for complex enterprise scenarios, including deep integrations, custom roles, automations and external content sources, so every demo and proposal is tailored and technically sound.

  • You analyse RFPs/RFIs and PvE documents, identify gaps, manage the Memorandum of Information (NVI/Q&A) process and craft high-quality qualitative narratives on topics such as security, architecture, accessibility and continuity.

  • You lead technical deep-dives, workshops and on-site UAT sessions, remove blockers in real time and build consensus with IT stakeholders, CISOs and C-level decision makers.

  • You map client IT landscapes, design complex integrations (SSO, AFAS, SAP, Learning Hub/DMS and others) and visualise data flows in professional architecture diagrams.

  • You navigate and translate security & privacy frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, BIO, DORA, Archives Act) into concrete product proof-points and commercial advantages.

  • You act as the bridge between Sales, Engineering, Product and Compliance — harvesting tribal knowledge, feeding market insights back into the roadmap and turning technical complexity into reusable commercial assets.

  • You use AI tools as your daily operating system: analysing lengthy RFPs, generating first-draft responses, accelerating narrative writing and building custom assistants while keeping human-in-the-loop quality and security standards.

  • You measure success by technical wins secured, sales cycles de-risked, time saved for the commercial team and long-term institutional trust built with enterprise clients — not just documents delivered.


Who you are

  • You have 3 to 7 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Pre-Sales, Technical Consulting or a similar role at a scaling B2B SaaS company, preferably EdTech or tech. You’ve moved beyond standard demos into complex enterprise solution design and tender support.

  • You have hands-on experience configuring platforms, scoping integrations, working with APIs and data models, and shipping working technical answers under tender deadlines.

  • You’re fluent in both the commercial conversation (with Account Executives and SDRs) and the technical conversation (with architects, CISOs and engineers).

  • You’re AI-native and product-minded: you diagnose requirements, design solutions, ship documentation and iterate with commercial outcomes in mind. AI is your building material.

  • You’re structured, detail-oriented, proactive and able to keep overview across multiple parallel tenders and stakeholder groups.

  • You think commercially — about which technical choices increase win probability, reduce risk and create long-term trust, not just technical elegance.

  • You’re a strong team player with excellent communication skills and the ability to make complex topics accessible and exciting.

  • You speak and write excellent Dutch (English is a plus).


What we offer

  • €60K - €80K a year including holiday allowence + 10K variabel.

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Hybrid working (3 days at the office / 2 days at home).

  • 25 holidays + an extra day off on your birthday.

  • A 3% pension contribution paid by Studytube via A.S.R.

  • A fully equipped gym at the office — work out before or after work and skip the trip to Basic-Fit.

  • €1,000 L&D budget per year, of which 50% can go towards wellbeing or your home-office setup.

  • In-company training via our own Studytube Academy: LevelUp.

  • A beautiful office in the Houthavens with a view over the IJ.

  • A company laptop (MacBook Air) + €10 allowance for using your own phone.

  • For a small contribution: a fully catered lunch with a choice of a hot meal, sandwiches or salad bar when you’re at the office.

  • The nicest colleagues, with a team outing every quarter and an annual company party.

About Studytube
Studytube makes professional development as accessible, easy, fun, and successful as possible. We believe it’s essential for companies to invest in employee development, now more than ever. That’s why we offer an all-in-one learning platform that inspires employees to grow—and we do so successfully. Our customer portfolio includes over 300 clients across various industries, ranging from 200 to 30,000 employees. Companies like Bol.com, ASR, CZ, Manpower, VolkerWessels, and Eneco are already inspiring their employees with our platform. Together with 200+ diverse and passionate colleagues, we focus on creating the best learning experience for our clients. Our goal? To become Europe’s #1 platform for professional development.

title: Data Engineer
description: Studytube maakt professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk. Achter het platform zit een groeiende stroom leerdata. Die moet klanten, de business en de AI-features die we bouwen écht verder helpen. Daar zoeken we een Data Engineer voor die de datalaag bezit. De rol Je komt in een klein datateam binnen Product & Tech en rapporteert aan de Head of Engineering. Je werk bedient twee takken. Business: rapportages voor commerce, management en investeerders. Product: de inzichten die klanten in het platform zien, zoals voortgang en budget. Collega’s bouwen de dashboards, jij zorgt dat de data eronder klopt en meebeweegt met het product. Je werkt dagelijks samen met een businessanalist en een productanalist, die ook met Looker en dbt werkt. Er komt nog een analist bij. Een ervaren data engineer sluit één dag per week aan en een Data Lead staat op de planning.  Wat je doet Je bent eigenaar van het Snowflake-platform: rollen en rechten, warehouse sizing en provisioning, tasks en kosten. Je beheert GitHub voor het dataplatform: branches, environments en automatisering met GitHub Actions. Je neemt Databricks, opgezet voor een high-security omgeving, over van een externe partij en bereidt de migratie van Snowflake naar Databricks voor, gepland voor volgend jaar. Je bouwt pipelines die incrementeel, idempotent, getest en gedocumenteerd zijn, en ontsluit bronnen via Fivetran of custom connectors. Je zorgt dat dbt Cloud betrouwbaar draait: afhankelijkheden, scheduling en failure handling. Je bewaakt freshness, volume en schema drift, en zoekt de root cause als iets breekt. Je ruimt de architectuur op, maakt het platform uitbreidbaar en bouwt GDPR-bewust: toegang, retentie en verwijdering zitten in het ontwerp. Je legt het fundament voor metrics waar sales, marketing en product op sturen, in plaats van handmatige Excels. Wie je bent Je hebt 3 tot 6 jaar productie-ervaring als data engineer. Je hebt de valkuilen al eens gezien en levert zonder platformteam achter je een geteste, gemonitorde oplossing op. Je bent proactief en signaleert zelf wat beter moet. Je bent op je plek in een scale-up: je kunt tegen wat chaos en je brengt structuur aan. Je legt trade-offs helder uit aan niet-technische collega’s. Je maakt analytics engineers en analisten productief. Kunnen zij een tabel niet vinden, begrijpen of vertrouwen, of lopen ze vast op tooling of toegang, dan is het werk niet af. Must-haves Databricks in productie (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog), bij voorkeur op Azure. Diepgaande ervaring met dbt (Cloud) in productie: Jinja, geautomatiseerd testen, deployment pipelines en environments. Ervaring met het opzetten en structureren van een Git-workflow: branchingstrategie, pull requests en code review. Terraform of andere infrastructure-as-code. Snowflake of een vergelijkbaar warehouse. Python en ingestie via Fivetran of custom connectors. Data tests als standaard, oog voor cloudkosten. Engels op professioneel niveau, schriftelijk en mondeling. Bereid tot een Nederlandse veiligheidsscreening (VGB). Mooi meegenomen : een warehouse-migratie, Looker of data contracts, gereguleerde of publieke omgevingen, B2B SaaS.  Stack Snowflake (huidig warehouse), Databricks (Azure), Fivetran, dbt, GitHub, Metabase, Looker. Wat we bieden Een competitief salaris en de ruimte om data engineering bij Studytube neer te zetten. Hybride werken: 3 dagen op kantoor in de Houthavens, 2 dagen thuis. 25 vakantiedagen plus een vrije dag op je verjaardag. 3% pensioen via a.s.r., volledig betaald door Studytube. € 1.000 leerbudget per jaar, waarvan de helft voor welzijn of je thuiswerkplek. LevelUp Academy, Studygym, MacBook Air en € 10 telefoonvergoeding. Verzorgde lunches tegen een kleine bijdrage, kwartaaluitjes en een jaarlijks bedrijfsfeest. Studytube is het all-in-one leerplatform voor meer dan 600 organisaties, onder wie Bol.com , a.s.r., CZ, Manpower en VolkerWessels. Met 200+ collega’s willen we het nummer 1-platform voor professionele ontwikkeling in Europa worden. De datalaag is nu de bottleneck. Wie die recht trekt, maakt de ambities op AI en klantwaarde mogelijk. Solliciteer via deze vacature. Vragen: . Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
